### Create `apps/api/test/integration/moderation-path.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { MEASURES, OUTCOME_PHRASES, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, outcomeWords, type NoticeItemStatus, type NoticeRequest } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, STATEMENT_WORDS, getRule, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { MemoryJobLock, type JobLock } from "../../src/lib/jobs";
import { dispatchRound } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { noticeStatus, submitNotice } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, authCaseCounts, imageStates, moderationCounts, newImageRow, newPostRow, postFrozen, refusal, saveText } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, notices, postTarget, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";

// Every test signs several decisions with real staff keys and runs a dispatch round: more than a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;
const HOUR = 60 * MIN;

/**
 * The path for child sexual abuse material as one flow (3c design, sections 7.5, 7.8 and 7.12), against the real
 * database, the real auth module and a scripted mailer: a moderator seals while an admin decides, and the admin gives
 * one of two answers, a seal for good or an answer without a seal. At each step: what the images are, what the author is
 * mailed, what every staff account is mailed, what the home screen lists, and, after the daily release, what whoever
 * reported reads. Every decision is confirmed with a real staff key. The file's last test holds it to leaving no row
 * behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the path for child sexual abuse material, from the seal taken while deciding to the admin's two answers", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let d: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let lock: JobLock;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** How far the dispatch job's clock stands ahead of the real one. */
  let aheadMs = 0;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    w.deps.now = () => new Date(Date.now() + aheadMs);
    lock = new MemoryJobLock(() => Date.now() + aheadMs);
    d = deciderWorld(w.apiDb, { auth: w.authForModeration, rateLimitStore: w.deps.limits });
    before = await counts();
    moderator = await d.staff("moderator");
    admin = await d.staff("admin");
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.close();
  });

  const counts = async (): Promise<Record<string, number>> => ({ ...(await moderationCounts(w.apiDb)), ...(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)) });
  /** The next daily release: the dispatch hour is moved to the next full hour at least twenty minutes on, the clock to a minute past it, and a round runs. */
  async function released() {
    const next = (Math.floor((Date.now() + aheadMs + 20 * MIN) / HOUR) + 1) * HOUR;
    w.deps.config = { ...w.deps.config, MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR: new Date(next).getUTCHours() };
    aheadMs += next + MIN - (Date.now() + aheadMs);
    w.ahead.limitsMs = aheadMs;
    expect(await dispatchRound(w.deps, lock)).toMatchObject({ marked: true, daily: true });
  }
  const decided = async (staff: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: Parameters<DeciderWorld["decideAs"]>[2]) => {
    const outcome = await d.decideAs(staff, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  async function sent(request: NoticeRequest) {
    const answer = w.remember(await submitNotice(w.deps, request, w.sender()));
    await w.moderation.settle();
    const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
    return { ...answer, caseId: items[0]!.case_id! };
  }
  const itemOf = async (notice: { ref: string; token?: string }) => (await noticeStatus(w.deps, { ref: notice.ref, token: notice.token! }, w.sender().netHash)).items[0]!;
  /** An item's outcome as its sender reads it, composed as the status page and the app compose it. */
  const wordsOf = (item: NoticeItemStatus, ruleId: string | null = null) =>
    outcomeWords({ outcome: item.outcome!, rule: ruleId === null ? null : { id: ruleId, title: getRule(ruleId)!.title }, suspect: item.suspect, sealed: item.sealed, unseen: item.unseen, noEffect: false, scope: item.scope });
  /** A post of a new account with this many images. */
  async function post(images: number) {
    const author = await w.account();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const mediaIds: string[] = [];
    for (let position = 0; position < images; position++) mediaIds.push(await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, position));
    return { author, postId, mediaIds };
  }
  /** The statements mailed to this address, in order. */
  const statements = (address: string) => w.mailer.to(address, "moderation_decision").map((mail) => mail.data);
  const paragraphsOf = async (decisionId: string) => statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.apiDb, decisionId))!.statement);
  const decidedAt = async (decisionId: string) => (await decisionStatement(w.apiDb, decisionId))!.statement.decidedAt;
  /** The mails that told this staff account of a decision that lifted the protection of reported images. */
  const lifted = async (staff: RealStaff) => w.mailer.to((await w.repo.findUserById(staff.id))!.email, "moderation_csam_lifted").map((mail) => mail.data);
  /** The home screen's three lists of the path, each cut down to one case. */
  async function home(caseId: string) {
    const overview = await w.moderation.forStaff.overview();
    const of = <T extends { caseId: string }>(list: { items: T[] }) => list.items.filter((item) => item.caseId === caseId);
    return { protectionLifted: of(overview.protectionLifted), sealsDeclined: of(overview.sealsDeclined), interimSeals: of(overview.interimSeals), whole: JSON.stringify(overview) };
  }

  test("a moderator seals while an admin decides, and the admin seals for good: the images are sealed for everyone throughout, the author is told each time with that decision's redress, no staff alert goes, and both reports read the sealed phrase", async () => {
    const { author, postId, mediaIds } = await post(2);
    const email = w.address();
    // A notice of illegality about the post, and then a report of child sexual abuse material about it: one case.
    const notice = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(postId)], { email }));
    const report = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
    expect(report.caseId).toBe(notice.caseId);
    expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible", "visible"]);
    const alerts = (await lifted(moderator)).length;

    // The moderator on duty seals without opening anything.
    const seal = await decided(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
    const first = await paragraphsOf(seal);
    expect(statements(author.email)).toEqual([{ subject: "seal_deciding", statement: first.join("\n") }]);
    expect(first[0]).toMatch(/^korbat sealed the images of your post of [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC \(2 in all\): nobody can see them, you included\.$/);
    // A decision taken while deciding ends with korbat's decision, and cannot be appealed.
    expect(first.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
    expect(first.join(" ")).not.toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.sealForGood);
    // The home screen lists the seal with who took it and what it covers.
    expect(await home(report.caseId)).toMatchObject({ interimSeals: [{ at: await decidedAt(seal), handle: moderator.handle, caseId: report.caseId, posts: 1, images: 2 }], protectionLifted: [] });

    // A moderator can neither answer the report nor lift the seal: each is an admin's.
    expect(await refusal(d.decideAs(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }))).toBe("admin_required");
    expect(await refusal(d.decideAs(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] }))).toBe("admin_required");
    expect(await refusal(d.decideAs(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: seal, actions: [act("unseal_media")] }))).toBe("admin_required");
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);

    // The admin's first answer: a seal for good, which closes the case.
    const final = await decided(admin, report.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
    const last = await paragraphsOf(final);
    expect(statements(author.email)).toEqual([expect.anything(), { subject: "seal_final", statement: last.join("\n") }]);
    expect(last[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.sealForGood);
    // The appeal with its last day, and the sentence that an appeal of a seal waits for the authorities.
    expect(last.at(-1)).toMatch(/^You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC:/);
    expect(last.at(-1)!.endsWith(` ${STATEMENT_WORDS.sealAppeal}`)).toBe(true);
    // Nothing was lifted: no staff account is alerted, and the seal taken while deciding, which ended with the case, is no longer listed.
    expect((await lifted(moderator)).length).toBe(alerts);
    expect(await home(report.caseId)).toMatchObject({ interimSeals: [], protectionLifted: [] });

    // After the release, the report and the notice the same decision answered both read the sealed phrase.
    await released();
    const reported = await itemOf(report);
    expect(reported).toMatchObject({ suspect: true, outcome: "restricted_rule", sealed: true, unseen: false, reexamination: null });
    expect(wordsOf(reported, "R2")).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    const noticed = await itemOf(notice);
    expect(noticed).toMatchObject({ suspect: false, outcome: "restricted_rule", sealed: true });
    expect(wordsOf(noticed, "R2")).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    expect(w.mailer.updatesTo(email).at(-1)!.data.lines.map((line) => line.outcome)).toEqual([SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed]);
  });

  test("the admin's second answer, without a seal, reaches through the report and no further: the seal taken while deciding ends, the author is told, every staff account is told at once, the home screen lists it, the report reads the no-action phrase, an earlier rule report is answered unseen, and a later one stays open for a moderator who can then see the images", async () => {
    const { author, postId, mediaIds } = await post(1);
    // A rule report, then the report of child sexual abuse material: the case's first and second item.
    const earlier = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
    const report = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
    expect(report.caseId).toBe(earlier.caseId);
    const seal = await decided(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed"]);
    // A second rule report arrives after it, in the same case: its third item.
    const later = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
    expect(later.caseId).toBe(report.caseId);
    const [toModerator, toAdmin] = [(await lifted(moderator)).length, (await lifted(admin)).length];

    // The admin answers through the report of child sexual abuse material, the second item, and no further: the range
    // the console sends on such a case.
    const answer = await decided(admin, report.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", throughSeq: 2 });
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
    expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(false);
    const [open] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ closed: boolean; answered_seq: number; intake_seq: number }>(sql`select closed_at is not null as closed, answered_seq, intake_seq from cases where id = ${report.caseId}::uuid`);
    expect({ ...open! }).toEqual({ closed: false, answered_seq: 2, intake_seq: 3 });

    // The author is told that what korbat did while deciding has ended; nothing of it can be appealed.
    const told = await paragraphsOf(answer);
    expect(statements(author.email)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ subject: "seal_deciding" }), { subject: "lifted_deciding", statement: told.join("\n") }]);
    expect(told[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.ended(MEASURES.seal_media.label));
    expect(told.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    // Every staff account, the admin's own included, is told at once who ended the protection and when: it cannot be undone.
    const alert = { handle: admin.handle, time: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC$/), what: "dismissed" };
    expect((await lifted(moderator)).slice(toModerator)).toEqual([alert]);
    expect((await lifted(admin)).slice(toAdmin)).toEqual([alert]);
    // And the home screen lists it for every staff member, while the seal it ended is no longer listed.
    expect(await home(report.caseId)).toMatchObject({ protectionLifted: [{ at: await decidedAt(answer), handle: admin.handle, caseId: report.caseId, kind: "dismissed" }], interimSeals: [] });

    // The moderator decides the rule report with the images in sight: an ordinary answer.
    await decided(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await released();
    const reported = await itemOf(report);
    expect(reported).toMatchObject({ suspect: true, outcome: "no_violation", sealed: false, unseen: false });
    expect(wordsOf(reported)).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    // The rule report that arrived before it was answered by the admin with the images out of sight, and says so;
    const unseen = await itemOf(earlier);
    expect(unseen).toMatchObject({ suspect: false, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true });
    expect(wordsOf(unseen)).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    // the one that arrived after it was judged with the images.
    const ruled = await itemOf(later);
    expect(ruled).toMatchObject({ suspect: false, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: false });
    expect(wordsOf(ruled)).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}.`);
    void seal;
  });

  test("a recorded choice not to seal is listed on the home screen without its reason; an admin who lifts a seal taken while deciding is told to every staff account as an unsealing, and the report keeps the post frozen until it is answered", async () => {
    const { author, postId, mediaIds } = await post(1);
    const report = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
    await saveText(w.apiDb, report.caseId, moderator.id, "seal_declined", "The report repeats one that was answered yesterday.");
    const listed = await home(report.caseId);
    expect(listed.sealsDeclined).toEqual([{ at: expect.any(String), handle: moderator.handle, caseId: report.caseId }]);
    expect(listed.whole).not.toContain("answered yesterday");

    // The seal is taken after all, and an admin lifts it while the report still waits.
    const seal = await decided(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    const before = (await lifted(moderator)).length;
    const lift = await decided(admin, report.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: seal, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
    expect(await imageStates(w.apiDb, mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
    // The report is unanswered: the post stays frozen, and no staff member is served its images.
    expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
    expect((await lifted(moderator)).slice(before)).toEqual([{ handle: admin.handle, time: expect.any(String), what: "unsealed" }]);
    const told = await paragraphsOf(lift);
    expect(statements(author.email).at(-1)).toEqual({ subject: "lifted_deciding", statement: told.join("\n") });
    expect(told).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.unsealed);

    // The admin's answer without a seal is a second entry: newest first, each with what it did.
    const answer = await decided(admin, report.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    expect((await lifted(moderator)).slice(before).map((mail) => mail.what)).toEqual(["unsealed", "dismissed"]);
    expect((await home(report.caseId)).protectionLifted).toEqual([
      { at: await decidedAt(answer), handle: admin.handle, caseId: report.caseId, kind: "dismissed" },
      { at: await decidedAt(lift), handle: admin.handle, caseId: report.caseId, kind: "unsealed" },
    ]);
    expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await w.cleanUp();
    await d.close();
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

 * What follows a decision's commit (3c design, section 7.5, step 4), and the statement it mails (section 10), against
 * the real database, the real auth module and a scripted mailer: the author's statement is mailed at once and its result
 * recorded; a burst of decisions by one staff account is told to every staff account; and the statement's data holds
 * what the decision did, as the author's screen and the console's preview render it. Every decision is confirmed with a
 * real staff key; what the tests store is removed again, and the file's last test holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the statement of reasons and what follows a decision's commit", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let d: DeciderWorld;
  let limits: MemoryStore;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    limits = new MemoryStore();
    // The decisions' own module: the real auth module's mails over the world's scripted mailer, and a limit store the test reads.
    d = deciderWorld(w.apiDb, { auth: w.authForModeration, rateLimitStore: limits });
    before = await counts();
    moderator = await d.staff("moderator");
    admin = await d.staff("admin");
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.close();
  });

  /** How many rows the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold. */
  const counts = async (): Promise<Record<string, number>> => ({ ...(await moderationCounts(w.apiDb)), ...(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)) });

  /** A post of a new account with an address, reported under a rule by another: its author, its id and its open case. */
  async function reportedPost(rule: "R1" | "R5" = "R1") {
    const [author, reporter] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const recorded = await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.rule(reporter.id, rule), live: [aPost(postId)] });
    return { author, postId, caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId! };
  }
  /** The id of a decision that committed. */
  const decided = (outcome: Awaited<ReturnType<DeciderWorld["decideAs"]>>): string => {
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  const mailState = async (decisionId: string) => {
    const [row] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ author_mail: string; mailed: boolean }>(sql`select author_mail, author_mail_at is not null as mailed from decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
    return { ...row! };
  };
  const statementOf = async (decisionId: string) => (await decisionStatement(w.apiDb, decisionId))!;
  const addressOf = async (staff: RealStaff) => (await w.repo.findUserById(staff.id))!.email;

  test("the author's statement is mailed at once, as the statement's own paragraphs, and recorded sent", async () => {
    const { author, postId, caseId } = await reportedPost();
    const id = decided(await d.decideAs(moderator, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] }));
    const mails = w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision");
    expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
    const found = await statementOf(id);
    // One function renders the statement for the mail, the author's screen and the console's preview.
    expect(mails[0]!.data).toEqual({ subject: "post_deciding", statement: statementParagraphs(found.statement).join("\n") });
    expect(found.statement).toMatchObject({
      kind: "interim",
      outcome: "restricted",
      ground: "incompatible",
      ruleId: "R1",
      source: "report",
      post: { id: postId },
      measures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
      reversals: [],
      endedMeasures: [],
      reviewed: null,

    expect(await mailState(id)).toEqual({ author_mail: "sent", mailed: true });

    expect(w.mailer.sent.filter((mail) => mail.template === "moderation_decision")).toHaveLength(1);

  test("a relay failure leaves the statement pending for the dispatch job; a refused address is recorded failed; a purged account has no address", async () => {
    const waiting = await reportedPost();

    expect(await mailState(pending)).toEqual({ author_mail: "pending", mailed: false });
    const refused = await reportedPost();

    expect(await mailState(failed)).toEqual({ author_mail: "failed", mailed: false });

    const { statement } = await statementOf(closing);
    expect(statement).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false }] });
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.ended(MEASURES.withhold.label));
    expect(paragraphs.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    const mails = w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision");
    expect(mails.map((mail) => mail.data.subject)).toEqual(["post_deciding", "lifted_deciding"]);
    expect(await mailState(closing)).toEqual({ author_mail: "sent", mailed: true });
    // A decision that told its author nothing mails nothing: a no-action decision on a case without a measure.
    const quiet = await reportedPost();
    const silent = decided(await d.decideAs(moderator, quiet.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));

    expect(w.mailer.to(quiet.author.email)).toHaveLength(0);

  test("a decision without a measure keeps its facts and its reason from its author: the statement's data and its mail hold neither, and the case's answer shows both to staff", async () => {
    const { author, caseId } = await reportedPost();

    // The closing decision restricts nothing, and its two texts are written and saved as the console saves them.
    const [facts, reason] = [`What the answer rested on, for staff ${randomUUID()}.`, `Why nothing was done, for staff ${randomUUID()}.`];
    const digests = { factsDigest: await saveText(w.apiDb, caseId, moderator.id, "facts", facts), reasonDigest: await saveText(w.apiDb, caseId, moderator.id, "reason", reason) };
    const closing = decided(await d.decideAs(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ...digests }));
    // The decision's row names both texts: they are the case's record.
    const [row] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ facts: string | null; reason: string | null }>(sql`select facts_digest as facts, reason_digest as reason from decisions where id = ${closing}::uuid`);
    expect(row).toEqual({ facts: digests.factsDigest, reason: digests.reasonDigest });
    // Its author is told that the withhold has ended, and nothing of the two texts: the statement's data holds neither.
    const { statement } = await statementOf(closing);
    expect(statement).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", measures: [], reversals: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "withhold" }], facts: null, reason: null });
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(statement);

    const { author, postId, caseId } = await reportedPost();

    const attempts = w.mailer.attempts.length;
    const quiet = decided(await d.decideAs(moderator, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] }));
    // The measure can never take effect, so its author is told nothing: the decision is recorded without a mail.
    expect((await statementOf(quiet)).statement.measures).toEqual([{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, noEffect: "deleted", sealed: null }]);
    expect(await mailState(quiet)).toEqual({ author_mail: "none", mailed: false });
    expect(w.mailer.attempts.slice(attempts).filter((mail) => mail.to === author.email)).toEqual([]);
    // Nothing is pending: the dispatch job finds no statement to send for it, however old the decision is.

    const recorded = await recordIntake(w.deps, { ground: ground.rule(reporter.id, "R6"), live: [anAccount(subject.id, subject.handle)] });
    const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
    const reset = decided(await d.decideAs(moderator, caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("reset_bio")] }));
    expect(mailSubjectOf((await statementOf(reset)).statement)).toBe("profile_deciding");
    const closing = decided(await d.decideAs(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
    const { statement } = await statementOf(closing);
    expect(statement.post).toBeNull();
    expect(statement.endedMeasures).toEqual([{ kind: "reset_bio", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: reset, oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R6" }]);
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement)[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.ended(MEASURES.reset_bio.label)} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.field("bio")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.oldValueKept}`);
    expect(w.mailer.to(subject.email, "moderation_decision").map((mail) => mail.data.subject)).toEqual(["profile_deciding", "lifted_deciding"]);

  test("twenty decisions by one staff account in the last 15 minutes are told to every staff account, the person's own included, at most once an hour", async () => {
    // A staff account of its own, so that only this test's decisions are counted; each one is made here, with the key.
    const busy = await d.staff("moderator");
    const [busyMail, adminMail] = [await addressOf(busy), await addressOf(admin)];
    const bursts = () => w.mailer.sent.filter((mail) => mail.template === "moderation_burst");
    const cases: string[] = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < 10; n++) cases.push((await reportedPost()).caseId);
    // Nineteen decisions raise nothing: a withhold on each of ten cases, and nine of them closed.
    for (const caseId of cases) decided(await d.decideAs(busy, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] }));
    for (const caseId of cases.slice(0, 9)) decided(await d.decideAs(busy, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
    expect(await recentDecisionsBy(w.apiDb, busy.id, BURST_WINDOW_MS)).toBe(BURST_ALERT_AT - 1);
    expect(bursts()).toHaveLength(0);
    // The twentieth: every staff account, the person's own included, with the person's handle and the count.
    decided(await d.decideAs(busy, cases[9]!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
    const recipients = bursts().map((mail) => mail.to);
    expect(recipients).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([busyMail, adminMail]));
    expect(new Set(bursts().map((mail) => JSON.stringify(mail.data)))).toEqual(new Set([JSON.stringify({ handle: busy.handle, count: String(BURST_ALERT_AT) })]));
    // The twenty-first, inside the hour: counted, and not told again.
    const told = bursts().length;
    const next = await reportedPost();
    decided(await d.decideAs(busy, next.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] }));
    expect(bursts()).toHaveLength(told);
    // Another staff account's decisions are counted on their own.
    const other = await reportedPost();
    decided(await d.decideAs(admin, other.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] }));
    expect(bursts()).toHaveLength(told);
    // The count is the person's rows of the last 15 minutes by the database's clock, whatever the limit store holds:
    // all 21 lie inside that window, and none inside its last millisecond.
    expect(await recentDecisionsBy(w.apiDb, busy.id, BURST_WINDOW_MS)).toBe(BURST_ALERT_AT + 1);
    expect(await recentDecisionsBy(w.apiDb, busy.id, 1)).toBe(0);
    // The alert's throttle is one key of the shared limit store with a window of an hour: the twentieth decision opened
    // it, the twenty-first met it, and this read is its third hit.
    const throttle = await limits.hit(burstAlertKey(busy.id), 60 * 60_000);
    expect(burstAlertKey(busy.id)).toBe(`moderation-burst:${busy.id}`);
    expect(throttle.count).toBe(3);
    expect(throttle.resetMs).toBeGreaterThan(59 * 60_000);
    expect(throttle.resetMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(60 * 60_000);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await w.cleanUp();
    await d.close();
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/mail/moderation-templates.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, outcomeWords } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { noticeTime } from "../../src/auth/flows/notify";
import type { MailMessage, NoticeUpdateData, NoticeUpdateLine, TemplateName } from "../../src/mail/mailer";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS, renderMail, renderNoticeUpdate, renderTemplate } from "../../src/mail/templates";

/**
 * The mails of deciding and of the dispatch (3c design, section 7.15): the author's statement, the staff alerts for a
 * burst of decisions, for a decision that lifted the protection of reported images and for cases that wait too long, and
 * the one structured mail, the daily update of decisions on a person's reports. Each is pinned word for word.
 */
const LAST_USER = "korbat staff never ask for your password or a code, and korbat does not read replies to this email.";
const LAST_STAFF = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
const paragraphs = (text: string) => text.trimEnd().split("\n\n");
const TIME = "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC";

/** No link of any kind, and the staff mails' last sentence. */
function linkless(r: { text: string; html: string }) {
  expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
  expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
  expect(paragraphs(r.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_STAFF);
}

describe("the closed union of templates", () => {
  test("holds 34 templates: the 25 before moderation cases and the nine of 3c", () => {
    // Every name is written out: a template added or dropped changes this list.
    const names = [
      "sign_in_code", "sign_up_code", "reauth_code", "new_device", "account_locked", "mfa_enabled", "mfa_disabled", "password_changed", "recovery_codes_regenerated", "sessions_revoked_all",
      "email_change_code", "email_changed", "email_change_reverted", "badge_verified", "badge_removed", "delete_account_code", "account_deleted", "passkey_added", "passkey_removed", "passkey_suspect",
      "recovery_code_used", "staff_key_added", "staff_session_started", "staff_key_suspect", "staff_keys_revoked",
      "notice_received", "notice_update", "moderation_decision", "moderation_urgent", "moderation_waiting", "moderation_burst", "moderation_reads", "moderation_reveal", "moderation_csam_lifted",
    ] as const satisfies readonly TemplateName[];
    expect(new Set(names).size).toBe(34);
    // Each name is a template the union holds, and the union holds no other: the assignment below would not compile.
    const all: Record<TemplateName, true> = Object.fromEntries(names.map((name) => [name, true])) as Record<(typeof names)[number], true>;
    expect(Object.keys(all)).toHaveLength(34);
  });
});

describe("moderation_decision: the statement of reasons, to its author", () => {
  const statement = ["korbat removed your post of 2026-10-01 12:00 UTC: other people can no longer see it.", "The facts: The post offers followers for money.", "You can appeal this decision once."].join("\n");

  test("the subject follows the decision's kind and outcome, from one table", () => {
    expect(DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS).toEqual({
      seal_deciding: "korbat sealed images of yours while it decides",
      seal_final: "korbat sealed images of yours",
      post_deciding: "A post of yours is under review on korbat",
      profile_deciding: "korbat reset part of your profile while it decides",
      post_restricted: "korbat restricted a post of yours",
      profile_restricted: "korbat restricted part of your profile",
      lifted_deciding: "korbat lifted a restriction it placed while deciding",
      reversed: "korbat reversed a decision about your account",
      appeal_kept: "korbat answered your appeal",
    });
    for (const [key, subject] of Object.entries(DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS)) expect(renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: key, statement }).subject, key).toBe(subject);
    // A subject that is no key of the table is a programming error, never printed as given.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "Click here to appeal", statement })).toThrow(/subject/);
  });

  test("the statement's paragraphs, one per line of the data, then where to read it, and that no korbat mail carries a link to act on a decision", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "post_restricted", statement });
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat removed your post of 2026-10-01 12:00 UTC: other people can no longer see it.",
      "The facts: The post offers followers for money.",
      "You can appeal this decision once.",
      "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|:[/][/]/);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
    // A staff text is only ever text: what it holds never becomes markup, and an empty line is no paragraph.
    const hostile = renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "post_restricted", statement: "The facts: <script>alert(1)</script>\n\nkorbat's reasons: <b>x</b>" });
    expect(hostile.html).toContain("&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;");
    expect(hostile.html).not.toMatch(/<script|<b>/);
    expect(paragraphs(hostile.text)).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "post_restricted" })).toThrow(/statement/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { statement })).toThrow(/subject/);
  });
});

describe("the staff alerts of deciding", () => {
  test("moderation_burst names the staff account and how many decisions it confirmed, tells its holder what to do, and carries no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { handle: "mod_anna", count: "20" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: many staff decisions in a short time");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "The staff account @mod_anna confirmed 20 decisions in the last 15 minutes.",
      "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not confirm them, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
      "If that was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(r);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/count/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { count: "20" })).toThrow(/handle/);
  });

  test("moderation_csam_lifted has two texts for what the decision did, and says what staff do next", () => {
    const data = { handle: "mod_anna", time: TIME, what: "unsealed" };
    const unsealed = renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", data);
    expect(unsealed.subject).toBe("korbat: reported images are no longer protected");
    expect(paragraphs(unsealed.text)).toEqual([
      `The staff account @mod_anna confirmed a decision at ${TIME} that lifted a seal.`,
      "Unless another seal or another open report of this kind still covers them, the images its case reaches are served again as before and staff may open them. After an answer without a seal, whoever is on duty opens them the same day and, where one breaks a rule or the law, opens a finding on its post. Nobody at korbat could open those images while they were protected.",
      "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not confirm it, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
      "The staff console's home screen lists every such decision of the last 30 days with its case. A seal for good is lifted only on the answer of the authority korbat reported the images to, and a seal taken while deciding only when it was taken in error: the operator compares this decision with their R2 records. If it was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke, and whoever is on duty opens a finding citing R2 on the post or the account and seals its images while deciding.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(unsealed);
    const dismissed = renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, what: "dismissed" });
    expect(paragraphs(dismissed.text)[0]).toBe(`The staff account @mod_anna confirmed a decision at ${TIME} that answered a report or finding of child sexual abuse material without a seal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(dismissed.text).slice(1)).toEqual(paragraphs(unsealed.text).slice(1));
    linkless(dismissed);
    // What it did is one of two words, never a text handed over.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, what: "released the images" })).toThrow(/what/);
    for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...rest } = data as Record<string, string>;
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", rest), key).toThrow(new RegExp(key));
    }
    // It names no case, no post and no person but the staff account.
    expect(renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, caseId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", author: "ada" }).text).toBe(unsealed.text);
  });

  test("moderation_waiting: one line for each lane with a case past its time, in lane order, a single case worded as one, and the cases that hold a measure taken while deciding", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane0Count: "2", lane0Oldest: TIME, lane1Count: "1", lane1Oldest: TIME, lane2Count: "12", lane2Oldest: TIME, interimCount: "3" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: cases are waiting longer than their response time");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `The urgent lane: 2 cases waiting longer than 24 hours; the oldest since ${TIME}.`,
      `Lane 1: 1 case waiting longer than 24 hours, since ${TIME}.`,
      `Lane 2: 12 cases waiting longer than 7 days; the oldest since ${TIME}.`,
      "3 cases have held a measure taken while deciding for more than 24 hours; their authors cannot appeal until the case is decided.",
      "Open the staff console. Until the phone alerts of sub-project 3e, this email is the only reminder.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(r);
    // Only the lanes that have such a case, and the measures' line only when there is one.
    const one = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane2Count: "1", lane2Oldest: TIME });
    expect(paragraphs(one.text)).toEqual([`Lane 2: 1 case waiting longer than 7 days, since ${TIME}.`, "Open the staff console. Until the phone alerts of sub-project 3e, this email is the only reminder.", LAST_STAFF]);
    const held = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { interimCount: "1" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)).toEqual([
      "1 case has held a measure taken while deciding for more than 24 hours; its author cannot appeal until the case is decided.",
      "Open the staff console. Until the phone alerts of sub-project 3e, this email is the only reminder.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    // A count without its time, and a mail about nothing, are programming errors.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane0Count: "2" })).toThrow(/lane0Oldest/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", {})).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });
});

describe("notice_update: decisions on a person's reports, once a day", () => {
  const POST = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
  const PAGE = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
  const TERMS = "http://localhost:8081/terms";
  const COURTS = "go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";
  const REEXAMINE = "You can ask korbat once, within six months and free of charge, to re-examine a moderator's decision to take no action: it is decided again as a new report.";
  const FINAL = "A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.";
  const line = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateLine> = {}): NoticeUpdateLine => ({
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    item: 1,
    link: POST,
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_legal", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null }),
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
  const update = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateData>): NoticeUpdateData => ({ signedIn: false, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [], ...more });

  test("signed out: one paragraph per line, the page of each notice it has a line for, that nothing was automated, and the courts", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`,
      "N-ABCDEFGH23, item 2 (http://localhost:8081/u/ada): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.",
      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.
    expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
  });

  test("signed in: no page link, and the re-examination points to Your reports", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `${REEXAMINE} Use korbat's Settings, Cases, Your reports.`,
      `You can also ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    // A signed-in update never carries a page or a receipt: handed either, it is refused rather than mailed.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }))).toThrow(/signed-in/);
  });

  test("the re-examination sentence goes only with a re-examinable line, and points to the page when signed out", () => {
    const withIt = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`${REEXAMINE} Use the page linked in this email for that report.`);
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`You can also ${COURTS}`);
    const without = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(without.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    expect(paragraphs(without.text)).toContain(`You can ${COURTS}`);
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/moderation-dispatch.test.ts`

```ts
import pino from "pino";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, OUTCOME_PHRASES, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_NO_SEAL, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RULEBOOKS } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { JobLock } from "../src/lib/jobs";
import { MemoryStore } from "../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration, type CreateModerationOptions } from "../src/moderation";
import { DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS, DISPATCH_JOB, WAITING_ALERT_KEY, WAITING_ALERT_WINDOW_MS, stillCalls, updateLine } from "../src/moderation/dispatch";
import type { OutcomeLineRow, UrgentItemRow } from "../src/moderation/repo";

/**
 * The dispatch job's rules that need no database (3c design, sections 5, 7.8 and 7.12): which unanswered item of the
 * urgent lane still calls for someone, what each field of a daily update's line says, and how the job is started. The
 * rounds themselves run against the database in test/integration/moderation-dispatch.test.ts.
 */

const config = { APP_ORIGIN: "http://localhost:8081" } as CreateModerationOptions["config"];

describe("which unanswered item of the urgent lane still calls for someone", () => {
  const item = (over: Partial<UrgentItemRow> = {}): UrgentItemRow => ({
    caseId: "c",
    targetType: "post",
    targetId: "t",
    suspect: false,
    arrivedMs: 1_000,
    interimAfter: false,
    noteAfter: false,
    declinedAfter: false,
    newestDeclinedMs: null,
    postHidden: false,
    ...over,
  });
  const served = (newestServedAt: number | null = 500) => ({ served: 1, newestServedAt: newestServedAt === null ? null : new Date(newestServedAt) });
  const none = { served: 0, newestServedAt: null };

  test("a suspect item whose case reaches a served image: only a recorded choice not to seal ends it, and only for the images of posts created before it", () => {
    const suspect = (over: Partial<UrgentItemRow> = {}) => item({ suspect: true, ...over });
    expect(stillCalls(suspect(), served())).toBe(true);
    // Not a note, not a decision taken while deciding: some reader is still served the images.
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ noteAfter: true, interimAfter: true }), served())).toBe(true);
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ declinedAfter: true, newestDeclinedMs: 2_000 }), served(1_500))).toBe(false);
    // A post with a served image created after the newest recorded choice starts it again,
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ declinedAfter: true, newestDeclinedMs: 2_000 }), served(2_001))).toBe(true);
    // also one created in the same millisecond: the alert errs on the side of repeating.
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ declinedAfter: true, newestDeclinedMs: 2_000 }), served(2_000))).toBe(true);
    // A choice recorded before the item arrived says nothing about the item.
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ declinedAfter: false, newestDeclinedMs: 900 }), served(100))).toBe(true);
    // What the case reaches must have been read for a suspect item.
    expect(() => stillCalls(suspect(), null)).toThrow();
  });

  test("a suspect item whose case reaches no served image: a decision taken while deciding, a note or a recorded choice not to seal after it arrived ends it", () => {
    const suspect = (over: Partial<UrgentItemRow> = {}) => item({ suspect: true, ...over });
    expect(stillCalls(suspect(), none)).toBe(true);
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ interimAfter: true }), none)).toBe(false);
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ noteAfter: true }), none)).toBe(false);
    expect(stillCalls(suspect({ declinedAfter: true, newestDeclinedMs: 2_000 }), none)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("any other item: a decision taken while deciding ends it; a note does only when the case is about an account or its post is not visible", () => {
    expect(stillCalls(item(), null)).toBe(true);
    expect(stillCalls(item({ interimAfter: true }), null)).toBe(false);
    // On a visible post a note never ends it.
    expect(stillCalls(item({ noteAfter: true }), null)).toBe(true);
    expect(stillCalls(item({ noteAfter: true, postHidden: true }), null)).toBe(false);
    expect(stillCalls(item({ noteAfter: true, targetType: "account" }), null)).toBe(false);
    // A recorded choice not to seal is about images: it says nothing about a threat.
    expect(stillCalls(item({ declinedAfter: true, newestDeclinedMs: 2_000, postHidden: true }), null)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("one line of the daily update", () => {
  const row = (over: Partial<OutcomeLineRow> = {}): OutcomeLineRow => ({
    id: "i",
    intakeId: "n",
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    contactId: "k",
    reporterId: null,
    position: 1,
    targetType: "post",
    targetId: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
    namedHandle: null,
    hasCase: true,
    suspect: false,
    shownOutcome: "no_violation",
    changed: false,
    reexamines: false,
    byDecision: true,
    reexamined: false,
    ruleId: null,
    rulesVersion: 2,
    decisionUnseen: false,
    sealed: false,
    noEffect: false,
    quotes: false,
    ...over,
  });
  const line = (over: Partial<OutcomeLineRow> = {}) => updateLine({ config }, row(over));

  test("a moderator's decision to take no action can be re-examined once: its line says so, with the item's reference, position and korbat address", () => {
    expect(line()).toEqual({
      ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
      item: 1,
      link: "http://localhost:8081/post/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
      outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}.`,
      reexamination: false,
      changed: false,
      reexaminable: true,
      unseen: false,
      automatic: false,
    });
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "not_evident" })).toMatchObject({ outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}.`, reexaminable: true });
    // Asked for already, it cannot be asked again.
    expect(line({ reexamined: true }).reexaminable).toBe(false);
    // An account's address is built from the handle as the notice named it.
    expect(line({ targetType: "account", namedHandle: "old_name" })).toMatchObject({ link: "http://localhost:8081/u/old_name", outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}` });
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer, a changed outcome and a link that named nothing are each marked, and none can be re-examined", () => {
    expect(line({ reexamines: true })).toMatchObject({ reexamination: true, reexaminable: false, unseen: false });
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "reversed", changed: true })).toMatchObject({ outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`, changed: true, reexaminable: false });
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "partly_reversed", changed: true }).outcome).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "not_available", hasCase: false, byDecision: false })).toMatchObject({ outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`, automatic: true, reexaminable: false });
    // After "not available" no scope sentence follows, whatever the link named.
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "not_available", hasCase: false, byDecision: false, targetType: "account", namedHandle: "nobody" }).outcome).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
  });

  test("a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION carries unseen and leaves the re-examination unspent, also as a re-examination's answer; asked again before a retried mail went out, it still carries unseen", () => {
    expect(line({ decisionUnseen: true })).toMatchObject({ outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true, reexaminable: true });
    expect(line({ decisionUnseen: true, reexamines: true })).toMatchObject({ outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, reexamination: true, unseen: true, reexaminable: true });
    expect(line({ decisionUnseen: true, reexamines: true, reexamined: true })).toMatchObject({ reexamination: true, unseen: true, reexaminable: false });
    // An item about an account is never worded this way, whatever its answering decision carries: its answer concerns
    // the display name and bio, which staff read. As a re-examination's answer it leaves nothing to ask again.
    expect(line({ targetType: "account", namedHandle: "a_name", decisionUnseen: true })).toMatchObject({ outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`, unseen: false, reexaminable: true });
    expect(line({ targetType: "account", namedHandle: "a_name", decisionUnseen: true, reexamines: true })).toMatchObject({ unseen: false, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false });
    // A restriction decided with the images out of sight is no such line, nor is a suspect item's own answer.
    expect(line({ decisionUnseen: true, shownOutcome: "restricted_legal" })).toMatchObject({ outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.restricted_legal}.`, unseen: false });
    expect(line({ decisionUnseen: true, suspect: true })).toMatchObject({ outcome: SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action, unseen: false });
  });

  test("a restriction names its rule in the rulebook the decision was made under, reads the sealed phrase after a seal, and says when it changed nothing", () => {
    const [v1, v2] = [RULEBOOKS[1].find((rule) => rule.id === "R6")!, RULEBOOKS[2].find((rule) => rule.id === "R6")!];
    expect(v1.title).not.toBe(v2.title);
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 1 }).outcome).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R6 (${v1.title}).`);
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 2 }).outcome).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R6 (${v2.title}).`);
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true, quotes: true }).outcome).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.restricted_legal}. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
    // Whatever the item's own ground, a decision that holds a seal is worded with the sealed phrase; about an account, with the suspect scope.
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", ruleId: "R2", sealed: true }).outcome).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, targetType: "account", namedHandle: "name" }).outcome).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
    // A finding's item restricted by a measure on the text, without a seal.
    expect(line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", ruleId: "R1", suspect: true }).outcome).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (${RULEBOOKS[2][0].title}). ${SUSPECT_NO_SEAL}`);
    // A suspect item about a quoting post has an item of its own for the quoted post, and no quote scope.
    expect(line({ suspect: true, quotes: true }).outcome).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
  });

  test("a restriction under a rule that no rulebook korbat holds has cannot be worded: the line is refused, never guessed", () => {
    expect(() => line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", ruleId: "R9", rulesVersion: 2 })).toThrow();
    expect(() => line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 99 })).toThrow();
    expect(() => line({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", ruleId: null })).toThrow();
  });
});

describe("the module's background work", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  /** The module over stand-ins that fail the test when a round touches them, and a lock that only records what it is asked. */
  function world(acquire: boolean) {
    const asked: { key: string; ttlMs: number }[] = [];
    const lock: JobLock = {
      acquire: async (key, _token, ttlMs) => {
        asked.push({ key, ttlMs });
        return acquire;
      },
      refresh: async () => undefined,
      release: async () => undefined,
    };
    const untouched = new Proxy({}, { get: () => () => Promise.reject(new Error("a round ran")) });
    const moderation = createModeration({
      apiDb: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["apiDb"],
      auth: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["auth"],
      social: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["social"],
      media: untouched as CreateModerationOptions["media"],
      rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(),
      config,
      logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });
    return { moderation, lock, asked };
  }

  test("startJobs runs the dispatch job under its own lock every ten minutes, from the end of the round before, until it is stopped", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    // Another instance holds the lock: this one asks for it at every turn and runs no round.
    const w = world(false);
    const stop = w.moderation.startJobs(w.lock);
    expect([DISPATCH_JOB, DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS]).toEqual(["moderation-dispatch", 10 * 60_000]);
    // The first round comes ten minutes after the start, not at once.
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS - 1);
    expect(w.asked).toEqual([]);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
    expect(w.asked).toEqual([{ key: "job:moderation-dispatch", ttlMs: DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS }]);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS);
    expect(w.asked).toHaveLength(2);
    stop();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3 * DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS);
    expect(w.asked).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  test("the queue-age alert has a key and a window of its own: once a day", () => {
    expect([WAITING_ALERT_KEY, WAITING_ALERT_WINDOW_MS]).toEqual(["moderation-waiting", 24 * 60 * 60_000]);
  });
});
```
