### Create `packages/contracts/test/outcomes.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE,
  ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE,
  ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN,
  CaseView,
  DecisionStatement,
  ITEM_OUTCOMES,
  OUTCOME_PHRASES,
  QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE,
  SEAL_DRAFTS,
  SUSPECT_NO_SEAL,
  SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES,
  StaffOverview,
  UNSEEN_NO_ACTION,
  outcomeWords,
  sealFactsDraft,
  type ItemOutcome,
  type OutcomeWordsInput,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * The words a report's sender reads for an outcome, and the console's fixed drafts for a seal (3c design, section 10).
 * Each table is the one place its words are written: the mails, the status page, the app's list and the console take
 * them from here, so this file pins every word once.
 */
const RULE = { id: "R1", title: "No sexual or pornographic content" };

/** One item's facts, plain unless a test says otherwise: a post that quotes nothing, answered by a decision that saw its images. */
const words = (outcome: ItemOutcome, facts: Partial<OutcomeWordsInput> = {}): string =>
  outcomeWords({ outcome, rule: outcome === "restricted_rule" ? RULE : null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null, ...facts });

describe("the outcome phrases", () => {
  test("there is exactly one phrase for each outcome an item can be shown, word for word", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(OUTCOME_PHRASES).sort()).toEqual([...ITEM_OUTCOMES].sort());
    expect(OUTCOME_PHRASES).toEqual({
      restricted_rule: "access restricted: it breaks korbat rule {rule} ({title})",
      restricted_legal: "access restricted: korbat found it illegal",
      no_violation: "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal",
      not_evident:
        "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules, and whether it is illegal cannot be seen without a detailed legal examination; a court or an authority can order its removal",
      not_available: "no action: the link names nothing korbat can show (checked automatically)",
      partly_reversed: "korbat reversed part of its decision to restrict it",
      reversed: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it",
    });
  });

  test("the sentences that follow an outcome, and the phrases of the path for child sexual abuse material, word for word", () => {
    expect(ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN).toBe("It was already not shown on korbat, so nothing changed now; korbat's restriction stays in force should that change.");
    expect(ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE).toBe("This answer concerns the account's display name and bio. korbat decides about its posts and images in cases of their own and does not report those here.");
    expect(QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE).toBe(
      "This answer concerns this post's own text and images. korbat decides about the post it quotes, shown inside its card, in a case of its own and does not report that here.",
    );
    expect(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE).toBe(
      "This answer concerns the account's display name and bio and, taken together, the images on its posts. korbat decides about single posts of the account, and about what its posts say, in cases of their own and does not report those here.",
    );
    expect(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES).toEqual({
      sealed: "access restricted: korbat sealed its images without opening them. They are shown to nobody, their author included, and are kept for the authorities.",
      no_action:
        "no action: korbat's staff do not open images reported this way. An admin found in the report, and in what korbat can read and still holds of it, no sufficient ground to seal images or to restrict anything else.",
    });
    expect(SUSPECT_NO_SEAL).toBe("No image was sealed; korbat's staff do not open images reported this way.");
    expect(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION).toBe(
      "no action for now: when korbat decided, its staff could not open this post's images, because a report of another kind about them was waiting or they were sealed. If your report is about an image, ask for a re-examination.",
    );
  });
});

describe("outcomeWords: one item's outcome as its sender reads it", () => {
  test("an ordinary item reads its outcome's phrase, a rule's with its id and title, and ends in one full stop", () => {
    expect(words("restricted_rule")).toBe("access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content).");
    expect(words("restricted_legal")).toBe("access restricted: korbat found it illegal.");
    expect(words("no_violation")).toBe("no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.");
    expect(words("not_evident")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}.`);
    expect(words("not_available")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(words("reversed")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
    // A phrase that fills nothing in never keeps a placeholder, and no outcome ends in two full stops.
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      for (const facts of [{}, { suspect: true }, { sealed: true }, { unseen: true }, { noEffect: true }, { scope: "account" as const }, { scope: "quote" as const }, { scope: "account_suspect" as const }]) {
        const text = words(outcome, facts);
        expect(text, `${outcome} ${JSON.stringify(facts)}`).not.toMatch(/[{}]|[.][.]|[.] [.]/);
        expect(text.endsWith("."), `${outcome} ${JSON.stringify(facts)}`).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });

  test("a restriction under a rule that is not named is refused: the phrase would keep its placeholder", () => {
    expect(() => outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_rule", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null })).toThrow(/rule/);
  });

  test("ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN follows a restricting outcome whose measures all changed nothing, a seal's included, and no other outcome", () => {
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { noEffect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    for (const outcome of ["no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { noEffect: true }), outcome).not.toContain(ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN);
  });

  test("ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about an account that are not suspect and whose decision sealed nothing", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      const text = words(outcome, { scope: "account" });
      expect(text.endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      expect(text, outcome).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
      for (const scope of [null, "quote", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE);
    }
    // After the already-not-shown sentence when both apply.
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { noEffect: true, scope: "account" })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN} ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about a post that quotes another, after ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN when both apply", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, { scope: "quote" }).endsWith(` ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      for (const scope of [null, "account", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE);
    }
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true, scope: "quote" })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about an account that are suspect or that a sealing decision answered, a rule report merged into a sealed account case among them", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, { scope: "account_suspect", suspect: true }).endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      for (const scope of [null, "account", "quote"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
    }
    // A rule report about an account that an answer with a seal answered: the sealed phrase, then the scope.
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" })).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("a suspect item is worded from SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, never from the four words for a finding alone", () => {
    expect(words("no_violation", { suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    expect(words("not_evident", { suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    // Answered by a measure on the post's text without a seal: the phrase of that finding, then that no image was sealed.
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { suspect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${SUSPECT_NO_SEAL}`);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { suspect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${SUSPECT_NO_SEAL}`);
    for (const outcome of ["no_violation", "not_evident", "restricted_rule", "restricted_legal"] as const) {
      for (const sealed of [false, true]) {
        const text = words(outcome, { suspect: true, sealed });
        expect(text === `${OUTCOME_PHRASES[outcome]}.` || text === "access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content).", `${outcome} ${sealed}`).toBe(false);
      }
    }
    // The other three outcomes are worded as for any item.
    expect(words("not_available", { suspect: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(words("reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
  });

  test("the sealed phrase stands for every item a sealing decision answered, suspect or not, in place of both restricting phrases", () => {
    for (const suspect of [false, true]) {
      expect(words("restricted_rule", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
      expect(words("restricted_legal", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    }
  });

  test("an item on another ground about a post, answered without action while nobody could open its images, reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, and no other item does", () => {
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("not_evident", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    // A restriction, a reversal and a link that named nothing keep their own words, and a suspect item its own phrase.
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { unseen: true }), outcome).not.toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    // An item about an account is never worded this way, whatever its decision's mark: it keeps the ordinary phrase with its scope.
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, scope: "account" })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
    expect(words("not_evident", { unseen: true, scope: "account_suspect" })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}. ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
    // On a post that quotes another the scope follows it as it follows any outcome.
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, scope: "quote" })).toBe(`${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });
});

describe("the console's fixed drafts for a seal", () => {
  test("SEAL_DRAFTS holds its eight texts, word for word", () => {
    expect(SEAL_DRAFTS).toEqual({
      facts: {
        notice_post: "korbat received a notice that reports images of this post as child sexual abuse material.",
        notice_account: "korbat received a notice that reports this account for child sexual abuse material. It does not say which images, so korbat sealed every image on the account's posts.",
        notice_added: "korbat received a notice about content on korbat that shows this post's images and reports them as child sexual abuse material.",
        finding_post: "A moderator reported images of this post as possible child sexual abuse material.",
        finding_account: "A moderator reported images on this account's posts as possible child sexual abuse material. korbat sealed every image on the account's posts.",
        finding_added: "A moderator reported content on korbat that shows this post's images as possible child sexual abuse material.",
      },
      reason: {
        deciding: "korbat's staff do not open images reported this way, so korbat has not assessed them. It hides them from everyone, you included, until an admin has answered the report.",
        final:
          "korbat's staff do not open images reported this way, so korbat has not assessed them. An admin found the report credible enough to keep the images sealed and to report them to the police, who can assess them.",
      },
    });
    expect(Object.keys(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts).length + Object.keys(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason).length).toBe(8);
  });

  test("none says that korbat found the images to be such material, and each reason says that staff do not open them", () => {
    for (const text of [...Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts), ...Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason)]) {
      expect(text).not.toMatch(/korbat found|is child sexual abuse material|are child sexual abuse material/);
    }
    for (const text of Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason)) expect(text).toContain("korbat's staff do not open images reported this way");
    // The two drafts for an added item never say that this post was reported, and name no other post.
    for (const text of [SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_added, SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_added]) expect(text).not.toMatch(/of this post as|this post was|quot/);
  });

  test("the facts draft follows the suspect items the decision considers: a notice when any came from a user, the added form when every one was added by korbat, else by the case's target", () => {
    const item = (source: "user" | "finding", added = false) => ({ source, added });
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_account);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_post);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_account);
    // A notice among findings makes it a notice's draft.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding"), item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    // Every item added for a quoted post (or a re-examination of one): the added form; one named item among them: the post's.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("user", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    expect(() => sealFactsDraft("post", [])).toThrow(/suspect item/);
  });
});

describe("the statement's data", () => {
  const statement = {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,

  test("DecisionStatement takes a decision's data, and refuses a reversal among the measures and a measure among the reversals", () => {

    expect(DecisionStatement.safeParse({ ...statement, measures: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DecisionStatement.safeParse({ ...statement, reversals: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    const sealed = { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 3, images: 7, deletedImages: 2 } };
    expect(DecisionStatement.parse({ ...statement, post: null, measures: [sealed] }).measures).toEqual([sealed]);
    const reviewed = { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 1, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code", decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    const lifted = { kind: "restore_bio", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" };
    expect(DecisionStatement.parse({ ...statement, kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, post: null, measures: [], reversals: [lifted], reviewed })).toMatchObject({ reviewed, reversals: [lifted] });
  });
});

describe("the home screen's three lists of the path for child sexual abuse material", () => {
  const overview = {
    lanes: [0, 1, 2].map((lane) => ({ lane, open: 0, oldestAt: null })),
    appealsWaiting: 0,
    reveals: { total: 0, items: [] },
    imagesToday: [],
    findingsToday: [],
    mailsWaiting: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 0 },
    mailsFailed: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 0 },
    releaseOverdue: 0,
    deferUnproven: false,

    interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: "2026-10-04T09:00:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna", caseId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", posts: 3, images: 7 }] },
  };

  test("StaffOverview carries the decisions that lifted the protection of reported images, the choices not to seal and the seals taken while deciding that are in force", () => {
    expect(StaffOverview.parse(overview)).toEqual(overview);
    for (const list of ["protectionLifted", "sealsDeclined", "interimSeals"] as const) {
      const { [list]: _left, ...rest } = overview;
      expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(rest).success, list).toBe(false);
    }
    // What a lifting decision did is one of two words.
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ ...overview.protectionLifted.items[0]!, kind: "restored" }] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.parse({ ...overview, protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ ...overview.protectionLifted.items[0]!, kind: "dismissed" }] } }).protectionLifted.items[0]!.kind).toBe("dismissed");
  });

  test("the decision route answers the case, and the contracts no longer name an answer of its own for it", async () => {
    const contracts = (await import("../src/index")) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(contracts.CaseDecisionResponse).toBeUndefined();
    expect(CaseView).toBeDefined();
  });
});
```

### Create `packages/rules/test/statement.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MEASURES, MEASURE_KINDS, RETENTION, REVERSAL_KINDS, SEAL_DRAFTS, appealDeadline, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, RULEBOOKS, STATEMENT_WORDS, getRule, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "../src/index";

/**
 * The statement of reasons (3c design, section 10): one pure function renders it for the author's screen, the console's
 * preview and the mail, from the decision's data and the versions it was made under. These tests hold it to the six
 * elements of Article 17(3) of the Digital Services Act for every kind of decision, and to the design's sentences word
 * for word.
 */
const POST = { id: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36", createdAt: "2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z" };
const POST_TIME = "2026-10-01 12:00 UTC";
const DECIDED = "2026-10-04T09:30:15.250Z";
const IMAGE = "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d";
const RESET_DECISION = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const NO_RESET = { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } as const;

const measure = (kind: MeasureKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["measures"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  noEffect: null,
  sealed: kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } : null,
  ...more,
});
const reversal = (kind: ReversalKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["reversals"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  ...NO_RESET,
  ...more,
});

/** A final removal of a post under R1, following a report: the plainest restricting decision. */
function statement(more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}): StatementInput {
  return {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
    reason: "That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
    source: "report",
    decidedAt: DECIDED,
    post: POST,
    measures: [measure("remove")],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
    ...more,
  };
}

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;
const text = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input).join("\n");
const appeal = (decidedAt: string) => REDRESS_TEXTS[1].appeal.replace("{deadline}", `${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(11, 16)} UTC`);

describe("statementParagraphs", () => {
  test("a final removal under a rule, paragraph by paragraph: what was done, where and how long, how it came to korbat, no automation, the rule as its version words it, the facts, the reason and the appeal", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toEqual([
      `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
      "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
      `It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
      "The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
      "korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
      appeal(DECIDED),
    ]);
    // The deadline is the appeal's own: six months after the decision, to the minute, in UTC.
    expect(text(statement())).toContain("until 2027-04-04 09:30 UTC");
  });

  test("a time is printed as the mails print one: the date and the minute, in UTC", () => {
    expect(text(statement({ post: { id: POST.id, createdAt: "2026-02-28T23:59:59.999Z" } }))).toContain("your post of 2026-02-28 23:59 UTC");
  });

  test("an old statement renders with the rulebook it was made under", () => {
    for (const version of [1, 2] as const) {
      for (const rule of RULEBOOKS[version]) {
        const out = text(statement({ ruleId: rule.id as StatementInput["ruleId"], rulesVersion: version }));
        expect(out, `${rule.id} v${version}`).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule ${rule.id}, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
      }
    }
    // R6 changed its title, R1 its text: version 1 keeps the old words.
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, or impersonation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 2 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, impersonation or coordinated manipulation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 2 }))).not.toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    // A version the package does not hold cannot be rendered as another one.
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ rulesVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/rulebook/);
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ redressVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/redress/);
  });

  test("a decision on the law names the law, never a rule, and says that it applies everywhere", () => {
    const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).", source: "notice" }));
    expect(out).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat cannot restrict content for one country alone, so this applies everywhere, which is more than the law of a single country asks for.");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat decided this following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act.");
    expect(out.join("\n")).not.toMatch(/korbat rule R[1-6]/);
  });

  test("the source is one of three phrases", () => {
    expect(W.source).toEqual({
      notice: "following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act",
      report: "following a report by another user",
      own_initiative: "found by a moderator",
    });
    expect(text(statement({ source: "own_initiative" }))).toContain("What this decision is about was found by a moderator.");
    for (const source of ["notice", "report", "own_initiative"] as const) expect(text(statement({ source })), source).toContain(W.source[source]);
  });

  describe("the redress text follows the decision's own kind and outcome, never a later event", () => {
    test("an interim decision carries the interim text and no appeal", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat hid your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(out).toContain("This applies everywhere korbat is available, for as long as korbat decides the case.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
      expect(out.join("\n")).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision once");
    });

    test("a final restriction carries korbat's appeal with its deadline", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement()).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
    });

    test("every other decision carries the text for a decision its author cannot appeal", () => {
      const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
      const others: StatementInput[] = [
        statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET }] }),
        statement({ outcome: "not_evident", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [] }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
      ];
      for (const input of others) expect(statementParagraphs(input).at(-1), `${input.kind} ${input.outcome}`).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });
  });

  test("every restricting decision carries the six elements of Article 17(3): each measure, kind, ground and rulebook version", () => {
    const grounds = [
      { ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R3" as const, legalReference: null },
      { ground: "illegal" as const, ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 130 of the criminal code." },
    ];
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
      for (const measureKind of MEASURE_KINDS) {
        if (!MEASURES[measureKind][kind]) continue;
        for (const ground of grounds) {
          for (const rulesVersion of [1, 2]) {
            const account = MEASURES[measureKind].target === "display_name" || MEASURES[measureKind].target === "bio";
            const input = statement({ kind, ...ground, rulesVersion, post: account ? null : POST, measures: [measure(measureKind)] });
            const out = statementParagraphs(input);
```

```ts
  const found = await userTexts(page);
  for (const text of found) seen.add(text);
  return found;

/** Waits for a locator to show, failing with what it looked for. */
async function shown(locator: Locator, timeout = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`not shown within ${timeout} ms: ${locator.toString()}`);
  }
}

/** A virtual CTAP2 authenticator that verifies its user: a security key on USB, or a platform one whose passkeys sync. */
async function addAuthenticator(kind: "device-bound security key" | "synced platform passkey"): Promise<string> {
  const synced = kind === "synced platform passkey";
  const { authenticatorId } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator", {
    options: {
      protocol: "ctap2",
      transport: synced ? "internal" : "usb",
      hasResidentKey: true,
      hasUserVerification: true,
      isUserVerified: true,
      automaticPresenceSimulation: true,
      // The flags a password manager's passkey reports, and a security key never does.
      defaultBackupEligibility: synced,
      defaultBackupState: synced,
    },
  });
  return authenticatorId;
}

/** How many times an authenticator's keys have signed: the virtual authenticator counts every signature. */
async function signaturesOf(authenticatorId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { credentials } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.getCredentials", { authenticatorId });
  return credentials.reduce((sum, credential) => sum + credential.signCount, 0);
}

/** How many times every staff key of the walk has signed. */
async function signatures(): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const id of staffAuthenticators) sum += await signaturesOf(id);
  return sum;
}

 * of the test runner's is put into the page, and nothing in the page evaluates it under the page's policy.
 */
async function until(expression: string, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries++) {
    if (await page.evaluate(expression)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/**
 * Waits until the fixtures have seen something. A text is saved when its field loses focus, and the request arrives a
 * moment after the key press that moved the focus.

async function arrived(check: () => boolean, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !check(); tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  if (!check()) throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/** The one image of the page: whether it is there, loaded as a real image of 2 by 2 pixels, from this address, drawn with this class. */
const imageIs = (src: string, className: string) =>

  test("a reveal: nothing to confirm until a reason is chosen and written; the reason saved first, the key confirming its digest; the name in a frame of its own, kept when the case cannot be read again and gone once the dialog is closed; options that bind another item are refused before the key is asked", async () => {
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_POST}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const before = await signatures();
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
    const confirm = dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    const why = dialog.getByLabel("Why");
    const written = dialog.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true });
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reveal who sent this" }).first().click();
    await shown(dialog);
    // No reason is chosen for the person and none is written: there is nothing to confirm yet.
    expect(await why.inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await why.selectOption("abuse_of_reporting");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("   ");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // The read of the case that follows the reveal will be refused: the page, and the name it has just shown, must stay.
    fixtures.state.recuseNextCaseRead = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(dialog.getByText("Revealed to you; recorded and shown to every staff member"));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const reason = fixtures.state.texts.find((text) => text.kind === "reveal_reason")!;
    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, text: "The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour." });
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toEqual([{ itemId: ITEM_REPORTER, reasonDigest: reason.digest }]);
    // The name alone in its frame, under the console's own line that says what it is, with its hidden characters to show.
    await shown(dialog.getByText("The reporter's handle:", { exact: true }));
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    await shown(dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Show hidden characters" }));
    // The refused read left the case on the page and says why on the page's error line; the name is still there.
    await shown(page.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("staff_recused") }));
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`).at(-1)!.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    // Shown once: with the dialog closed the page holds the name nowhere.
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close" }).click();
    await dialog.waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    expect(await userTexts(page)).not.toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await page.locator("#root").innerText()).not.toContain("a_reporter");
    await clean();

    // The server asks the key to confirm the reveal of another item: the key is never asked, and nothing is revealed.
    const reveals = fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/reveal")).length;
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reveal who sent this" }).nth(1).click();
    await why.selectOption("impersonation_claim");
    await written.fill("The notifier claims to be impersonated.");
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(messageFor("step_up_mismatch")));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/reveal")).length).toBe(reveals);
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toHaveLength(1);
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
    await clean();
  });

  test("a decision whose step-up options bind other params is refused before the key is asked; the draft stays, and confirmed again it is recorded without its texts being saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path.endsWith("/decisions")).length;
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome this person may decide on the case; the page opens on a restriction.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.restricted, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    // A restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason before anything can be confirmed.
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure));
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus: the facts when the reason was begun, the reason now.
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "reason", text: "It sells followers, which the rule names." });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    // Under both fields of a restriction: the rule on personal data, and that the author receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.personalData, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.done.remove("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`The facts: ${TYPED_FACTS}`);
    expect(await preview.last().textContent()).toMatch(/^You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until /);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);

    // The API asks the key to confirm another decision than the one the page built: the key is never asked.
    const [options, posted] = [fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed, sent()];
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(1);
    // The confirmation saved nothing more: both texts were on the server before it. What was chosen and written is still there.
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the decision itself: the saved texts are used as they are.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    const [facts, reason] = fixtures.state.texts.slice(-2);
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions[1]).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_POST,
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 4, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: facts!.digest, reasonDigest: reason!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });

  test("an admin's composer on a case with an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material: every outcome listed first, the choice not to seal only while deciding, and an answer without a measure that needs its facts, tells its author nothing and leaves the later report open", async () => {
    const [asked, before] = [fixtures.state.imageRequests.length, await signatures()];
    fixtures.state.role = "admin";
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_ADMIN}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome an admin may decide; beside them, that an answer now is given unseen.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.adminFinal).count()).toBe(0);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.unseen));
    // While deciding, the seal and the choice not to seal stand side by side.
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.interim).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }));
    // Deciding the case, an admin seals for good or answers without a seal: the choice not to seal is not offered.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze));
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.unseen));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);

    // An answer without a measure: no kind is asked, the category the key will confirm is shown, and the facts are needed.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "When" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "Measures" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Ground").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Category").inputValue()).toBe("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC");
    await composer.getByLabel("Category").selectOption("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // Under both fields: never to say what the images are, and that the author never receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(`${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor, { exact: false }).count()).toBe(0);
    // Nothing was done while deciding on this case, so the answer is told to nobody, and the page says so in the preview's place.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview").count()).toBe(0);
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("Nothing in the report or in the post supports it.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason and the facts saved when their fields lost focus");
    const written = (kind: string) => fixtures.state.texts.slice(saved).find((text) => text.kind === kind)!;
    expect(written("facts")).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_ADMIN, text: TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    await clean();

    await confirm.click();
    // The answer reaches the newest report of child sexual abuse material: the rule report that arrived after it stays open.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${COMPOSER.recorded} ${COMPOSER.leftForLater(1)}`));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_ADMIN,
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 3, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [], factsDigest: written("facts").digest, reasonDigest: written("reason").digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the answer with its facts, for staff, and a composer for the report left open.
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 4", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    const after = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    expect(await after.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(1);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked);
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    // The steps that follow are a moderator's again: each opens its page anew, and reads who is signed in.
    fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case that another staff member decided meanwhile: a save that failed is worded under its field and made again by the confirmation, the refusal is worded in place, the case is read again with the draft kept, and confirmed again the decision is recorded without a text saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const REASON = "That is what the rule names.";

    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // A moderator's own page again: no outcome of an admin's is on it that this person may not take.
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await arrived(() => requests("POST", "/texts").length === 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    // The reason's save meets the minute's limit when its field loses focus: the words stand under the field, and the text stays.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "rate_limited";
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: NOTE_WORDS.rate_limited }));
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429]);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(REASON);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    await clean();

    // Another staff member withholds the post while this page still shows the case as it read it.
    fixtures.decideBehindThePage(CASE_CHANGED);
    const read = requests("GET", "").length;
    await confirm.click();
    // The confirmation saved the reason, the key signed the decision the page showed, and the API refused it: in place.
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("case_changed") }));
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.filter((made) => made.caseId === CASE_CHANGED)).toEqual([]);
    // The page read the case again, once: the other decision is on it, and the composer follows the case as it now stands.
    await arrived(() => requests("GET", "").length === read + 1, "the case read again");
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 2", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(OTHER_STAFF);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.noEffect));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text").first().textContent()).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.done.withhold("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.already("post")}`);
    // The refusal's words stay, the reason's own refusal is gone now that it is saved, and the draft is as its person left it.
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("case_changed") }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: NOTE_WORDS.rate_limited }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(REASON);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(requests("GET", "")).toHaveLength(read + 1);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, on the version the page now shows: the texts are used as they were saved.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 2);
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409, 201]);
    const mine = fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_CHANGED);
    expect(mine.map((text) => [text.kind, text.text])).toEqual([
      ["facts", TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS],
      ["reason", REASON],
    ]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_CHANGED,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 2, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: mine[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine[1]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 3", { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByRole("alert").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a draft's texts come back after a reload: each was saved when its field lost focus, a refused save is worded under its field with the text kept, a saved text is restored with its digest, one answered with other words under its digest is dropped, and the decision names the text saved before the reload", async () => {
    const [before, options] = [await signatures(), fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed];
    const QUOTING = 'The reporter wrote "this account spams one link everywhere".';
    const REASON = "The post repeats one link, which the rule names.";
    const saves = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}/texts`).map((r) => r.status);
    const mine = () => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_DRAFTS);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "facts", text: TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS });
    // A text that quotes what someone wrote about the case is refused where it was written, and nothing of it is lost.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "text_quotes_user";
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(QUOTING);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("text_quotes_user") }));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(QUOTING);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422]);
    expect(mine()).toHaveLength(1);
    // Written again in the person's own words, the refusal's words go, and the text is saved when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await composer.getByRole("alert").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: "reason", text: REASON });
    // No key was asked for any of it.
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options);
    await clean();

    // A reload before any confirmation: the case's answer brings the saved texts back. This one answers the reason with
    // other words under the digest of what was saved: the page holds each text to its digest, and drops that one.
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = { caseId: CASE_DRAFTS, kind: "reason" };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const again = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await shown(again);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await page.content()).not.toContain(FORGED_DRAFT);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201]);
    await clean();

    // A measure and a reason later the key confirms the decision. The click that confirms takes the focus from the
    // reason's field: that save ends first, the confirmation saves nothing, and the facts are the ones saved before the reload.
    await again.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await again.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201, 201]);
    expect(mine().map((text) => text.kind)).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "reason"]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_DRAFTS,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 1, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: mine()[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine()[2]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = null;
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });
```

```ts
/**

 * have rows to show, and the home screen's sign-ins reach back past 7 days. Actions, targets and actors take hostile
 * values in turn.

function auditLog(now: number): AuditEntry[] {
  const rows: AuditEntry[] = [];

    const kind = seq % 4 === 0 ? "revoked" : seq % 9 === 0 ? "hostile" : "signin";

/** The authenticator data inside a CBOR attestation object: the byte string under the text key "authData". */
function authDataOf(attestationObject: Buffer): Buffer | null {
  // A CBOR text string of 8 bytes (0x68) spelling authData, then the byte string (major type 2) it maps to.
  const key = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0x68]), Buffer.from("authData")]);
  const at = attestationObject.indexOf(key);
  if (at === -1) return null;
  let i = at + key.length;
  const head = attestationObject[i];
  if (head === undefined || head >> 5 !== 2) return null;
  let length = head & 0x1f;
  i += 1;
  // The length is in the head itself, or in the 1, 2 or 4 bytes after it.
  if (length === 24) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt8(i);
    i += 1;
  } else if (length === 25) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt16BE(i);
    i += 2;
  } else if (length === 26) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt32BE(i);
    i += 4;
  } else if (length > 23) {
    return null;
  }
  return attestationObject.subarray(i, i + length);
}

function flagRefusal(flags: number | null): "staff_key_refused" | "staff_key_not_user_verified" | "staff_key_not_device_bound" | null {
  if (flags === null) return "staff_key_refused";
  if ((flags & FLAG_UV) === 0) return "staff_key_not_user_verified";
  if ((flags & (FLAG_BE | FLAG_BS)) !== 0) return "staff_key_not_device_bound";
  return null;
}

  }
  return jar;
}

/** The staff cookies as the API sets them: __Host- names, Secure, Path=/, SameSite=Strict, 12 hours, the session's HttpOnly. */
const COOKIE = "Path=/; Secure; SameSite=Strict";
const SESSION_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff";
const CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";

  staff_key_refused: 400,

}

/**

function ceremonyChallenge(purpose: "staff_signin" | "staff_register", binding: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(CEREMONY_CHALLENGE.bindingBytes)): string {

  const bytes = randomBytes(c.bytes);

  bytes[c.purposeAt] = CHALLENGE_PURPOSES[purpose];

export const MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS = { text_not_found: 409, text_invalid: 422, text_quotes_user: 422, rate_limited: 429, image_refused: 404, staff_recused: 403, case_changed: 409, snapshot_mismatch: 409 } as const;

/** The kinds of text a decision or a correction names: the ones a case's answer hands back as drafts while no decision has named them. */
const DRAFT_KINDS: readonly string[] = ["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason"];

function applyDecision(view: CaseView, params: CaseDecidedParams, written: { facts: string | null; reason: string | null; legalReference: string | null }, staffHandle: string): void {
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  const id = randomUUID();
  const corrected = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === params.reviewsDecisionId);
  const actions: CaseDecision["actions"] = params.actions.map((action) => {
    const lifts: readonly string[] | null = MEASURES[action.kind].lifts;
    if (lifts !== null) {
      const lifted = corrected?.actions.find((held) => held.inForce && lifts.includes(held.kind) && held.mediaId === action.mediaId);
      if (lifted) {
        lifted.inForce = false;
        lifted.liftedBy = id;
      }
      return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: false, reversesActionId: lifted?.id ?? null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null };
    }
    const reach = view.suspicion?.reach ?? { posts: 0, images: 0 };
    const sealed = action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: reach.posts, images: reach.images, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] } : null;
    return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed };
  });
  const suspect = view.items.some((item) => item.outcome === null && item.suspect);
  view.decisions = [
    ...view.decisions,
    {
      id,
      kind: params.kind,
      outcome: params.outcome,
      ground: params.ground,
      ruleId: params.ruleId,
      rulesVersion: params.rulesVersion,
      redressVersion: params.redressVersion,
      category: params.category,
      categoryKeyword: params.categoryKeyword,
      source: "report",
      decidedAt: at,
      staffHandle,
      throughSeq: params.throughSeq,
      answersFromSeq: params.kind === "final" ? view.answeredSeq + 1 : null,
      reviewsDecisionId: params.reviewsDecisionId,
      snapshotId: params.snapshotId,
      suspect,
      unseen: false,
      needsAdmin: false,
      endedInterim: false,
      facts: written.facts,
      reason: written.reason,
      legalReference: written.legalReference,
      actions,
    },
  ];
  view.history = [...view.history, { at, event: "decision", refId: id, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: params.kind, outcome: params.outcome, staffHandle, result: null }];
  view.stateVersion += 1;

  const outcome = params.outcome === "restricted" ? ITEM_OUTCOMES.restricted[params.ground ?? "incompatible"] : ITEM_OUTCOMES[params.outcome];

  view.closedAt = at;
```
