### Create `apps/admin/src/screens/Composer.tsx`

```tsx
import { FINDING_CATEGORIES, MEASURES, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type DecisionActionParams, type MeasureKind, type RuleId, type TdbCategory } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RULES, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "@korbat/rules";
import {
  COMPOSER,
  complete,
  correctable,
  correctionChoices,
  holds,
  kindsOffered,
  lawOffered,
  leftOpen,
  liftable,
  liftedKind,
  measuresOffered,
  noEffectOf,
  offeredDraft,
  outcomesListed,
  previewOf,
  previewable,
  sealOffered,
  snapshotImages,
  statementSent,
  suspectOpen,
  throughSeqOf,
  toggled,
  type CaseDraft,
  type DraftTextKind,
  type StaffRole,
} from "../compose";
import { COMPOSER_KINDS, COMPOSER_OUTCOMES, COMPOSER_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { dateTime, UserText } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel } from "../words";

/**
 * The decision composer (3c design, section 8): the outcome first, then, for a restriction, the kind, the ground and the
 * measures this target and kind allow; the category; the facts and the reason; and the preview, which is the statement
 * exactly as its author will receive it. What it offers follows the case and the person's role; the database checks
 * every rule again when the key has confirmed. A correction ("Lift what was done while deciding", "Correct this
 * decision") takes the composer's place while it is open.
 */

/** "Do not seal now": the reason as typed, and what became of saving it. */
export interface DecliningState {
  reason: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export interface ComposerViewProps {
  view: CaseView;
  role: StaffRole;
  draft: CaseDraft;
  /** The time the preview is rendered for: the decision's time, were it confirmed now. */
  now: Date;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** The refusal of a text's save, worded in place under its field. */
  textErrors: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>>;
  declining: DecliningState | null;
  onChange(change: Partial<CaseDraft>): void;
  /** A text's field lost focus: the text is saved, without the key. */
  onTextBlur(kind: DraftTextKind): void;
  /** "Seal the images this case reaches". */
  onSeal(): void;
  onConfirm(): void;
  onDeclineOpen(): void;
  onDeclineChange(reason: string): void;
  onDeclineSave(): void;
  onDeclineClose(): void;
  onCancelCorrection(): void;
}

/**
 * The statement as its author will receive it, each paragraph as text in a frame of its own direction. In its place the
 * page says so when there is nothing to show yet (a restriction without a measure), nothing it can show (a post whose
 * snapshot cannot be shown: no creation time is made up), or nothing that is sent.
 */
function Preview({ view, draft, now }: Pick<ComposerViewProps, "view" | "draft" | "now">) {
  // A restriction without a measure has no statement yet: the page says so rather than show one that restricts nothing.
  if (draft.kind !== "correction" && draft.outcome === "restricted" && !draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)) {
    return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure}</p>;
  }
  if (!previewable(view)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.previewAfterSnapshot}</p>;
  let input: StatementInput;
  let paragraphs: string[];
  try {
    input = previewOf(view, draft, now);
    paragraphs = statementParagraphs(input);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  // A decision that restricts nothing and ends nothing sends its author nothing: no statement is shown as if it were sent.
  if (!statementSent(input)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="frame preview">
      <h4>Preview: the statement as its author will receive it</h4>
      {paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => (
        <p key={index} className="frame-text">
          <UserText>{paragraph}</UserText>
        </p>
      ))}
      {draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media") ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.sealSettled}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One of the draft's texts, as its person types it. It is saved when the field loses focus; a refusal of that save stands under the field. */
function TextField({ id, label, kind, rows, props, under }: { id: string; label: string; kind: DraftTextKind; rows: number; props: ComposerViewProps; under: string[] }) {
  const { draft } = props;
  const refused = props.textErrors[kind];
  return (
    <>
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <textarea
        id={id}
        rows={rows}
        value={draft.written[kind]}
        disabled={props.busy}
        onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ written: { ...draft.written, [kind]: event.target.value } })}
        onBlur={() => props.onTextBlur(kind)}
      />
      {refused ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {refused}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {under.map((sentence) => (
        <p key={sentence} className="hint">
          {sentence}
        </p>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function Confirm({ props, onCancel }: { props: ComposerViewProps; onCancel?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <>
      {props.error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {props.error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" className="primary" onClick={props.onConfirm} disabled={props.busy || !complete(props.view, props.draft)} aria-busy={props.busy}>
          Confirm with your staff key
        </button>
        {onCancel ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={props.busy}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/** A correction of one decision: what of it to lift, the reason, and the preview. */
function CorrectionView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const choices = correctionChoices(view, draft, role);
  if (!decision || choices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
        <p>Nothing of that decision is in force any more.</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const deciding = decision.kind === "interim";
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{deciding ? COMPOSER.liftLabel : COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}. A correction only lifts: choose what of it to lift.`}</p>
      <ul className="plain">
        {choices.map(({ measure, reversal }) => (
          <li key={measure.id}>
            <label>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
              <span>{MEASURES[reversal.kind].label}</span>
              {measure.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{measure.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
            </label>
            {reversal.kind === "unseal_media" ? <p className="notice">{deciding ? COMPOSER.sealInError : COMPOSER.sealForGood}</p> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the correction" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

/** One measure's checkbox, with the image it names for an image measure, and the sentence that it changes nothing now when it would not. */
function Measure({ measure, props, images }: { measure: MeasureKind; props: ComposerViewProps; images: string[] }) {
  const { view, draft } = props;
  const ofImage = MEASURES[measure].target === "image";
  const held = draft.actions.find((action) => action.kind === measure);
  const action: DecisionActionParams = { kind: measure, mediaId: ofImage ? (held?.mediaId ?? images[0] ?? null) : null };
  if (ofImage && images.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <li>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={held !== undefined} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled({ ...draft, actions: draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure) }, action, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
        <span>{MEASURES[measure].label}</span>
      </label>
      {ofImage && held !== undefined ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <label htmlFor={`compose-image-${measure}`} className="visually-hidden">
            Which image
          </label>
          <select
            id={`compose-image-${measure}`}
            value={action.mediaId ?? ""}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: [...draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure), { kind: measure, mediaId: images.find((image) => image === event.target.value) ?? null }] })}
          >
            {images.map((image, index) => (
              <option key={image} value={image}>
                {`Image ${index + 1}`}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </>
      ) : null}
      {noEffectOf(view, action) !== null ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.noEffect}</p> : null}
    </li>
  );
}

export function ComposerView(shown: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role } = shown;
  if (shown.draft.kind === "correction") return <CorrectionView {...shown} />;
  // What the draft holds is shown as far as it is offered, and that is what the key confirms.
  const draft = offeredDraft(view, role, shown.draft);
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { ...shown, draft };
  const kinds = kindsOffered(view, role);
  if (kinds.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>
        <p>{COMPOSER.closed}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const kind = draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim";
  const listed = outcomesListed(view, role);
  const outcome = draft.outcome;
  const restricts = outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  const suspect = suspectOpen(view);
  const sealChosen = draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media");
  const images = snapshotImages(view);
  const left = leftOpen(view);
  const rule = RULES.find((each) => each.id === draft.ruleId) ?? RULES[0];
  const postHidden = view.target.type === "post" && view.target.state !== null && view.target.state !== "visible";
  // Beside the two outcomes of a decision without a measure, whenever they are listed: on a post whose images cannot be
  // opened, such an answer to a report about an image is given unseen.
  const unseen = view.target.type === "post" && !view.imagesAllowed && listed.some((each) => each !== "restricted");
  // Under the facts and under the reason: on a case with an unanswered suspect item, never to say what the images are;
  // then the rule on personal data, with where the text goes. The texts of a decision without a measure never reach its author.
  const underTexts = [...(suspect.length > 0 ? [COMPOSER.neverWrite] : []), restricts ? COMPOSER.personalData : `${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`];

  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>

      <fieldset>
        <legend>Outcome</legend>
        {kinds.includes("final") ? null : <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.adminFinal}</p>}
        {listed.map((each) => (
          <label key={each}>
            {/* An outcome without a measure is a final decision's: choosing it makes the decision final, and puts its measures away. */}
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="compose-outcome"
              checked={outcome === each}
              disabled={props.busy}
              onChange={() => props.onChange(each === "restricted" ? { outcome: each } : { outcome: each, kind: "final", actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null) })}
            />{" "}
            <span>{COMPOSER_OUTCOMES[each]}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
        {unseen ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.unseen}</p> : null}
      </fieldset>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>When</legend>
          {kinds.map((each) => (
            <label key={each}>
              {/* A measure belongs to one kind: the other kind's measures are put away with the change. */}
              <input type="radio" name="compose-kind" checked={kind === each} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ kind: each, actions: [] })} /> <span>{COMPOSER_KINDS[each]}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {suspect.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="banner suspect">
          <p>{(view.suspicion?.reach.served ?? 0) > 0 ? COMPOSER.onlySealEnds : COMPOSER.noteEnds}</p>
          {sealOffered(view, kind, role) ? (
            <div className="actions">
              <button type="button" onClick={props.onSeal} disabled={props.busy || sealChosen}>
                {MEASURES.seal_media.label}
              </button>
              {/* The choice not to seal belongs beside the seal taken while deciding: an admin deciding the case seals for good or answers without a seal. */}
              {kind === "interim" ? (
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineOpen} disabled={props.busy || props.declining !== null}>
                  Do not seal now
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {props.declining === null || kind !== "interim" ? null : (
            <div className="dialog" role="group" aria-labelledby="decline-title">
              <h4 id="decline-title">Do not seal now</h4>
              <p>{COMPOSER.declineWords}</p>
              <label htmlFor="decline-reason">Why you do not seal now</label>
              <textarea id="decline-reason" rows={3} value={props.declining.reason} disabled={props.declining.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onDeclineChange(event.target.value)} />
              {props.declining.error ? (
                <p role="alert" className="error">
                  {props.declining.error}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="actions">
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineSave} disabled={props.declining.busy || props.declining.reason.trim() === ""} aria-busy={props.declining.busy}>
                  Record this choice
                </button>
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineClose} disabled={props.declining.busy}>
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {role === "admin" && kind === "final" ? (
            <>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze}</p>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.unseen}</p>
              {view.target.type === "post" ? <p>{COMPOSER.admin.answersEarlier}</p> : null}
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.afterwards}</p>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : view.lane === 0 && (postHidden || view.target.type === "account") ? (
        <p className="notice">{view.target.type === "account" ? COMPOSER.noteAdviceAccount : COMPOSER.noteAdvicePost}</p>
      ) : null}

      {restricts ? (
        <>
          <label htmlFor="compose-ground">Ground</label>
          <select
            id="compose-ground"
            value={law ? "illegal" : "incompatible"}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange(event.target.value === "illegal" ? { ground: "illegal", terrorist: false } : { ground: "incompatible", terrorist: false, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[draft.ruleId] })}
          >
            <option value="incompatible">A korbat rule</option>
            {lawOffered(view, kind) ? <option value="illegal">The law</option> : null}
          </select>
          {law ? (
            <>
              <TextField id="compose-legal" label="Legal reference" kind="legal_reference" rows={2} props={props} under={[]} />
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={draft.terrorist} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ terrorist: event.target.checked })} /> <span>Terrorist content (Regulation (EU) 2021/784, Article 2(7))</span>
              </label>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <label htmlFor="compose-rule">Rule</label>
              <select id="compose-rule" value={draft.ruleId} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ ruleId: event.target.value as RuleId, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[event.target.value as RuleId] })}>
                {/* A decision under R2 rests on a report or finding of child sexual abuse material: it is offered only where one is unanswered. */}
                {RULES.filter((each) => each.id !== "R2" || suspect.length > 0).map((each) => (
                  <option key={each.id} value={each.id}>{`${each.id}: ${each.title}`}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <p>{rule.text}</p>
              <div className="examples">
                <div>
                  <h5>Allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.allowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h5>Not allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.notAllowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {/* Every decision carries a category, so every decision shows the one the key will confirm. */}
      <label htmlFor="compose-category">Category</label>
      <select id="compose-category" value={draft.category} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ category: event.target.value as TdbCategory })}>
        {FINDING_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
          <option key={category} value={category}>
            {categoryLabel(category)}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {sealChosen ? (
              <li>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "seal_media") })} /> <span>{`${MEASURES.seal_media.label}: chosen`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ) : null}
            {measuresOffered(view, kind).map((measure) => (
              <Measure key={measure} measure={measure} props={props} images={images} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {/* A restriction needs both texts; a decision without a measure may carry them, for the case's record. */}
      <TextField id="compose-facts" label="Facts" kind="facts" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />
      <TextField id="compose-reason" label="Reason" kind="reason" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />

      {kind === "final" && left.length > 0 && liftable(view).length > 0 ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures taken while deciding</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {liftable(view).map((reversal) => (
              <li key={`${reversal.kind} ${reversal.mediaId ?? ""}`}>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
                  <span>{`Lift: ${MEASURES[liftedKind(reversal)].label}`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
      {kind === "final" && suspect.length > 0 && left.length > 0 ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.staysOpen(throughSeqOf(view), left.length)}</p> : null}

      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Beside a decision with a measure in force: "Lift what was done while deciding" or "Correct this decision", for whoever may. */
export function CorrectControl({ view, decision, role, disabled, onCorrect }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; role: StaffRole; disabled: boolean; onCorrect(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  const offered = correctable(view, decision, role);
  if (offered === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onCorrect(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {offered.label}
    </button>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/dispatch.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { RETENTION, appealDeadline, outcomeWords, type ItemOutcome, type OutcomeWordsInput } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { getRule } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { AccountMailResult, NoticeUpdateLine, NotifierUpdatePart, NotifierUpdateResult } from "../auth";
import { createJob, type JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import { MailUnavailable } from "../mail/mailer";
import { alertUrgentLane, staffAlert } from "./alerts";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { itemLink, receiptMessage, sendReceipt } from "./intake";
import {
  contactsOwed,
  foldedReceipts,
  giveUpOutcomeMails,
  giveUpReceiptsAndAuthorMails,
  pendingAuthorMails,
  pendingOutcomeLines,
  pendingReceipts,
  recordCarriedReceipt,
  recordOutcomeMails,
  releaseOutcomes,
  urgentItems,
  waitingCases,
  type MailState,
  type NoticeRow,
  type OutcomeLineRow,
  type UrgentItemRow,
} from "./repo";
import { sendStatement } from "./statement";

/**
 * The dispatch job (3c design, sections 7.8 and 7.12): every ten minutes it repeats the staff alerts that are still due,
 * runs the daily release once its hour has come, sends the receipts and statements a relay failure left pending, mails
 * each address and account one update of the outcomes released to it, and gives up what stayed unsent for five days.
 *
 * A round runs its steps in the order 5, 3, 1, 2, 4, 6 of the design's list: the alerts first, and the daily release,
 * which writes only to the databases, before any mail, so it never waits behind a relay. Every step runs in a try of its
 * own, and so does every mail: a failure is logged with the step and the row's id, never an address, and leaves the row
 * as it was, so a row that keeps failing never stops the alerts, the release or another row's mail. It stays pending
 * until the last step gives it up.
 *
 * Every time the job compares is its own clock's (`deps.now()`), handed to the database as a parameter, so one clock
 * decides what is fifteen minutes or five days old, and a test can move it.
 */

const MINUTE_MS = 60_000;
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * MINUTE_MS;

/** The job's name: its lock is `job:moderation-dispatch`, and its log lines carry it. */
export const DISPATCH_JOB = "moderation-dispatch";
/** The time between the end of one round and the start of the next. */
export const DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS = 10 * MINUTE_MS;
/** A receipt, a statement and an urgent item are the job's once they are this old: until then the request that made them is still at work on them. */
const DUE_AFTER_MS = 15 * MINUTE_MS;
/** How many pending receipts one round sends. */
const RECEIPTS_PER_ROUND = 100;
/** How long a cut-off's marker is kept: two days, so a marker is still there for every round of its own day. */
const MARKER_TTL_MS = 2 * DAY_MS;
/** How long the question "is the marker set?" holds the key when the process dies between asking and letting go. */
const MARKER_PROBE_MS = 30_000;

/** The key and the window of the queue-age alert. */
export const WAITING_ALERT_KEY = "moderation-waiting";
export const WAITING_ALERT_WINDOW_MS = DAY_MS;

/** A round's cut-off: the latest dispatch hour (UTC) at or before the round's start. */
export function cutoffOf(start: Date, hour: number): Date {
  const today = Date.UTC(start.getUTCFullYear(), start.getUTCMonth(), start.getUTCDate(), hour);
  return new Date(today <= start.getTime() ? today : today - DAY_MS);
}

/**
 * The marker of a cut-off's release, by the cut-off's day and hour. Because the key holds the hour, a changed dispatch
 * hour gives a cut-off whose release has not run. It lives beside the jobs' locks, which a restore of the database does
 * not bring back: the README's restore steps delete the markers.
 */
export const dispatchMarkerKey = (cutoff: Date) => `moderation-dispatched:${cutoff.toISOString().slice(0, 13)}`;

/** What one round did, for its log line and for the tests. */
export interface DispatchReport {
  /** The urgent lane's repeat: what became of the alert, or "none" when no item still calls for someone. */
  urgent: "sent" | "throttled" | "unsent" | "nothing_waiting" | "none";
  /** The queue-age alert: what became of it, or "none" when no case is past its time. */
  waiting: "sent" | "throttled" | "unsent" | "none";
  /** How many items the daily release changed, or null when it did not run in this round. */
  released: number | null;
  /** Whether the cut-off's release, both halves, has finished: before this round or in it. */
  marked: boolean;
  /** Whether this round ran the release to its end and wrote the cut-off's marker itself: the daily round. */
  daily: boolean;
  /** The receipts and the statements whose result this round recorded. */
  receipts: number;
  statements: number;
  /** The addresses' contacts and the accounts whose update the relay took. */
  outcomeMails: number;
  givenUp: { receipts: number; authorMails: number; outcomes: number };
}

/** What a mail's result is recorded as; nothing is recorded where the relay could not take the mail, so the next round sends it again. */
const RECORDED: Record<NotifierUpdateResult | AccountMailResult, MailState | null> = {
  sent: "sent",
  suppressed: "suppressed",
  no_address: "no_address",
  // A contact the janitor has forgotten has no address any more.
  forgotten: "no_address",
  // The relay refused the address for good: no later try changes that.
  refused: "failed",
  unavailable: null,
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 5: the alerts

/**
 * Whether an unanswered item of the urgent lane still calls for someone (3c design, section 7.12), in its three cases.
 *   1. A suspect item whose case reaches an image that is still served: until a choice not to seal is recorded on the
 *      case after the item arrived, and then only while no post with a served image was created after the newest such
 *      choice. Nothing else ends it short of the item's answer: after a note, a withhold or a field reset some reader, the
 *      uploader included, is still served the images. A seal ends it by leaving no served image.
 *   2. A suspect item whose case reaches no served image: until a decision taken while deciding, a note or a recorded
 *      choice not to seal comes after the item arrived.
 *   3. Any other item: while no decision taken while deciding came after it and, when the case is about an account or its
 *      post is not visible, no note did either. On a visible post a note never ends it: the post is withheld or decided.
 * The two times of case 1 are compared to the millisecond, and a post created in the same millisecond as the recorded
 * choice counts as created after it: the alert errs on the side of repeating.
 */
export function stillCalls(item: UrgentItemRow, reach: { served: number; newestServedAt: Date | null } | null): boolean {
  if (item.suspect) {
    if (reach === null) throw new Error("a suspect item is judged by what its case reaches");
    if (reach.served > 0) {
      if (!item.declinedAfter || item.newestDeclinedMs === null) return true;
      return reach.newestServedAt !== null && reach.newestServedAt.getTime() >= item.newestDeclinedMs;
    }
    return !(item.interimAfter || item.noteAfter || item.declinedAfter);
  }
  const noteCounts = item.targetType === "account" || item.postHidden;
  return !item.interimAfter && !(noteCounts && item.noteAfter);
}

/**
 * The open cases that hold an unanswered item of the urgent lane which is older than 15 minutes and still calls for
 * someone. What a case reaches is read once for a case, and only for a case that holds a suspect item. An alert fails
 * open: a case whose reach cannot be read counts as calling, and the failure is logged with the case's id, so one case
 * that keeps failing never silences the lane.
 */
export async function casesCalling(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "media" | "log">, now: Date): Promise<string[]> {
  const items = await urgentItems(deps.apiDb, new Date(now.getTime() - DUE_AFTER_MS));
  const reaches = new Map<string, { served: number; newestServedAt: Date | null }>();
  const calling = new Set<string>();
  for (const item of items) {
    if (calling.has(item.caseId)) continue;
    let reach = reaches.get(item.caseId) ?? null;
    if (item.suspect && reach === null) {
      try {
        reach = await deps.media.reach({ type: item.targetType, id: item.targetId });
      } catch (err) {
        deps.log.error({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: "urgent", caseId: item.caseId }, "moderation-dispatch: what a case reaches could not be read; the case counts as calling");
        calling.add(item.caseId);
        continue;
      }
      reaches.set(item.caseId, reach);
    }
    if (stillCalls(item, reach)) calling.add(item.caseId);
  }
  return [...calling];
}

/** The urgent lane's repeat: while a case still calls, the alert is sent again under the key and window of the first one. */
async function repeatUrgent(deps: ModerationDeps, now: Date): Promise<DispatchReport["urgent"]> {
  if ((await casesCalling(deps, now)).length === 0) return "none";
  return alertUrgentLane(deps);
}

/**
 * The queue-age alert, at most once a day: per lane the cases past its response time with the oldest one's time, and the
 * open cases that have held a measure taken while deciding for more than a day, whose author cannot appeal it.
 */
async function alertWaiting(deps: ModerationDeps, now: Date): Promise<DispatchReport["waiting"]> {
  const waiting = await waitingCases(deps.apiDb, now);
  if (waiting.lanes.length === 0 && waiting.interim === 0) return "none";
  return staffAlert(deps, WAITING_ALERT_KEY, WAITING_ALERT_WINDOW_MS, { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: waiting.lanes, interim: waiting.interim });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 3: the daily release

/**
 * Whether the marker is set. The lock a job runs under is also the store of its markers, and it can only take a key or
 * let it go: the question takes the key for a moment, which fails when the marker is there, and lets it go again. A
 * process that dies in between leaves the key for half a minute, not for the marker's two days.
 */
async function markerSet(lock: JobLock, key: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const probe = randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
  if (!(await lock.acquire(key, probe, MARKER_PROBE_MS))) return true;
  await lock.release(key, probe);
  return false;
}

/**
 * The daily release, until the cut-off's marker is set. (a) The database releases every item answered before the cut-off
 * and every changed outcome. (b) Every contact whose notice is still owed something is kept for another six months. The
 * marker is set once both have finished, so a round that fails in between runs the step again: the release then releases
 * nothing new, and no outcome mail goes before (b) has moved each contact's day.
 *
 * When the marker cannot be asked for, the step runs: it only repeats what a finished release leaves as it is. The round
 * is the daily one only when its own write of the marker was accepted. A marker that could not be written is logged, and
 * the next round that can write it is the daily one: a receipt that rides alone goes out once a day, never once a round.
 */
async function dailyRelease(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock, now: Date, report: DispatchReport): Promise<void> {
  const cutoff = cutoffOf(now, deps.config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR);
  const key = dispatchMarkerKey(cutoff);
  try {
    if (await markerSet(lock, key)) {
      report.marked = true;
      return;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.warn({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: "release" }, "moderation-dispatch: the release's marker could not be read; the release runs again");
  }
  report.released = await releaseOutcomes(deps.apiDb, cutoff);
  const owed = await contactsOwed(deps.apiDb);
  if (owed.length > 0) await deps.auth.forgetNotifierAfter(owed, appealDeadline(now));
  report.marked = true;
  try {
    report.daily = await lock.acquire(key, "done", MARKER_TTL_MS);
    if (!report.daily) deps.log.warn({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: "release" }, "moderation-dispatch: the release's marker was not taken; the next round runs the release again");
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.warn({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: "release" }, "moderation-dispatch: the release's marker could not be set; the next round runs the release again");
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 4: the outcome mails

/**
 * One line of the daily update, from a released item (3c design, section 7.8, step 4, and section 5). The outcome's words
 * are the contracts' one composition, with the scope the status page gives the same item; the other fields say which of
 * the mail's sentences go with the line.
 */
export function updateLine(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "config">, row: OutcomeLineRow): NoticeUpdateLine {
  const outcome = row.shownOutcome as ItemOutcome;
  const noAction = outcome === "no_violation" || outcome === "not_evident";
  let scope: OutcomeWordsInput["scope"] = null;
  if (row.targetType === "account") scope = row.suspect || row.sealed ? "account_suspect" : "account";
  else if (row.hasCase && !row.suspect && row.quotes) scope = "quote";
  // "No action for now": decided while nobody could open the post's images, on an item about a post that is not itself suspect.
  const unseen = noAction && row.decisionUnseen && row.targetType === "post" && !row.suspect;
  let rule: OutcomeWordsInput["rule"] = null;
  if (outcome === "restricted_rule") {
    // The rule in the wording of the rulebook the decision was made under.
    const found = row.ruleId === null || row.rulesVersion === null ? undefined : getRule(row.ruleId, row.rulesVersion);
    if (!found) throw new Error("the item's restriction names no rule of a rulebook korbat holds");
    rule = { id: found.id, title: found.title };
  }
  return {
    ref: row.ref,
    item: row.position,
    link: itemLink(deps, row),
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome, rule, suspect: row.suspect, sealed: row.sealed, unseen, noEffect: row.noEffect, scope }),
    reexamination: row.reexamines,
    changed: row.changed,
    // Only a moderator's decision to take no action can be examined again, once; an answer given with the images out of
    // sight does not spend that, also when it answered a re-examination.
    reexaminable: row.byDecision && noAction && !row.reexamined && (!row.reexamines || unseen),
    unseen,
    automatic: !row.hasCase,
  };
}

/** The log line of a mail that did not go: a relay that could not take it is expected and tried again; anything else is a fault to read. */
function logUnsent(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "log">, err: unknown, step: string, row: Record<string, string | string[]>): void {
  if (err instanceof MailUnavailable) deps.log.warn({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step, ...row }, "moderation-dispatch: a mail was not sent; it stays pending for the next round");
  else deps.log.error({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step, ...row }, "moderation-dispatch: a row failed and was left as it was; the round goes on");
}

/**
 * The outcome mails: every released item whose mail is pending, whichever round released it.
 *   - Signed out, the lines go by contact to the auth module, which alone knows which contacts share an address and sends
 *     each address one update. A receipt the 24-hour cap folded rides with its contact's lines; in the daily round a
 *     contact with a folded receipt and nothing else is passed too, so its address gets an update of receipts alone. In
 *     later rounds a folded receipt goes only with its own contact's retried lines, so an address gets one update a day.
 *   - Signed in, they go as one update per account. An item whose reporter was forgotten has nobody to mail.
 * Each line and each carried receipt records its result only while it is still pending. Where the relay could not take a
 * mail nothing is recorded, and the next round sends it again.
 */
async function outcomeMails(deps: ModerationDeps, report: DispatchReport): Promise<void> {
  const q = deps.apiDb;
  const rows = await pendingOutcomeLines(q);
  const folded = new Map<string, NoticeRow>((await foldedReceipts(q)).map((notice) => [notice.contactId!, notice]));

  // One part for each contact, which is one notice; one list for each account.
  const byContact = new Map<string, { ref: string; items: string[]; lines: NoticeUpdateLine[] }>();
  const byAccount = new Map<string, { items: string[]; lines: NoticeUpdateLine[] }>();
  const nobody: string[] = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    let line: NoticeUpdateLine;
    try {
      line = updateLine(deps, row);
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { itemId: row.id });
      continue;
    }
    if (row.contactId !== null) {
      const part = byContact.get(row.contactId) ?? { ref: row.ref, items: [], lines: [] };
      part.items.push(row.id);
      part.lines.push(line);
      byContact.set(row.contactId, part);
    } else if (row.reporterId !== null) {
      const update = byAccount.get(row.reporterId) ?? { items: [], lines: [] };
      update.items.push(row.id);
      update.lines.push(line);
      byAccount.set(row.reporterId, update);
    } else {
      nobody.push(row.id);
    }
  }

  // Signed out. The parts keep the order of their notices, so an address's update lists them as they were sent.
  const parts: NotifierUpdatePart[] = [];
  const carried = new Map<string, NoticeRow>();
  const withReceipt = async (contactId: string, part: { ref: string; lines: NoticeUpdateLine[] }): Promise<void> => {
    const notice = folded.get(contactId);
    if (!notice) {
      parts.push({ contactId, ref: part.ref, lines: part.lines });
      return;
    }
    try {
      const receipt = await receiptMessage(deps, notice);
      carried.set(contactId, notice);
      parts.push({ contactId, ref: part.ref, lines: part.lines, receipt: { ref: receipt.ref, receivedAt: receipt.receivedAt, items: receipt.items } });
    } catch (err) {
      // The receipt could not be built: the lines go without it, and it waits for the next daily round.
      logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { intakeId: notice.id });
      if (part.lines.length > 0) parts.push({ contactId, ref: part.ref, lines: part.lines });
    }
  };
  for (const [contactId, part] of byContact) await withReceipt(contactId, part);
  if (report.daily) {
    for (const [contactId, notice] of folded) if (!byContact.has(contactId)) await withReceipt(contactId, { ref: notice.ref, lines: [] });
  }
  if (parts.length > 0) {
    let results = new Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>();
    try {
      results = await deps.auth.mailNotifierUpdates(parts);
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { contacts: String(parts.length) });
    }
    for (const part of parts) {
      const state = RECORDED[results.get(part.contactId) ?? "unavailable"];
      if (state === null) continue;
      try {
        await recordOutcomeMails(q, byContact.get(part.contactId)?.items ?? [], state);
        const notice = carried.get(part.contactId);
        if (notice) await recordCarriedReceipt(q, notice.id, state);
        if (state === "sent") report.outcomeMails++;
      } catch (err) {
        logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { contactId: part.contactId });
      }
    }
  }

  // Signed in: one update per account, through the account's own address.
  for (const [accountId, update] of byAccount) {
    try {
      const state = RECORDED[await deps.auth.mailAccount(accountId, { template: "notice_update", lines: update.lines })];
      if (state === null) continue;
      await recordOutcomeMails(q, update.items, state);
      if (state === "sent") report.outcomeMails++;
    } catch (err) {
      // The rows are the items: the account is the reporter, whom no log line names.
      logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { itemIds: update.items });
    }
  }

  // The reporter's link was forgotten with their account: there is nobody to mail.
  if (nobody.length > 0) await recordOutcomeMails(q, nobody, "no_address");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the round

/**
 * One round. `lock` is the store the job's own lock lives in, where the daily release keeps its markers.
 */
export async function dispatchRound(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock): Promise<DispatchReport> {
  const now = deps.now();
  const report: DispatchReport = { urgent: "none", waiting: "none", released: null, marked: false, daily: false, receipts: 0, statements: 0, outcomeMails: 0, givenUp: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 0 } };
  const step = async (name: string, run: () => Promise<void>) => {
    try {
      await run();
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: name }, "moderation-dispatch: a step failed; the round goes on");
    }
  };
  const due = new Date(now.getTime() - DUE_AFTER_MS);

  // 5. The alerts, each in a try of its own: a case whose reach cannot be read never holds the queue-age alert back.
  await step("urgent", async () => {
    report.urgent = await repeatUrgent(deps, now);
  });
  await step("waiting", async () => {
    report.waiting = await alertWaiting(deps, now);
  });

  // 3. The daily release.
  await step("release", () => dailyRelease(deps, lock, now, report));

  // 1. The receipts a relay failure left pending. sendReceipt records every result but a relay failure, which it logs
  // and leaves pending; any other fault it throws, and the row is logged here with the step and left as it was.
  await step("receipts", async () => {
    for (const intakeId of await pendingReceipts(deps.apiDb, due, RECEIPTS_PER_ROUND)) {
      try {
        const state = await sendReceipt(deps, intakeId);
        if (state !== "pending" && state !== "none") report.receipts++;
      } catch (err) {
        logUnsent(deps, err, "receipts", { intakeId });
      }
    }
  });

  // 2. The statements that were not mailed after their decision's commit, as they are mailed there.
  await step("statements", async () => {
    for (const decisionId of await pendingAuthorMails(deps.apiDb, due)) {
      try {
        if ((await sendStatement(deps, decisionId)) !== "none") report.statements++;
      } catch (err) {
        logUnsent(deps, err, "statements", { decisionId });
      }
    }
  });

  // 4. The outcome mails, only once the cut-off's release has finished, so each contact's day was moved before its lines go.
  let outcomesTried = false;
  if (report.marked) {
    await step("outcomes", async () => {
      await outcomeMails(deps, report);
      outcomesTried = true;
    });
  }

  // 6. What stayed unsent for five days is given up, without another attempt. Outcome lines only in a round that tried
  // them, after it, so each is tried at least once even when the daily release kept failing for longer than that.
  await step("give-up", async () => {
    const gone = await giveUpReceiptsAndAuthorMails(deps.apiDb, now, RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays);
    report.givenUp.receipts = gone.receipts.length;
    report.givenUp.authorMails = gone.authorMails.length;
    for (const id of gone.receipts) deps.log.warn({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, kind: "receipt", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
    for (const id of gone.authorMails) deps.log.warn({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, kind: "statement", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
    if (!outcomesTried) return;
    const lines = await giveUpOutcomeMails(deps.apiDb, now, RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays);
    report.givenUp.outcomes = lines.length;
    for (const id of lines) deps.log.warn({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, kind: "outcome", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
  });

  // One line for a round that did something, so the day's release and its mails can be found in the log: counts only.
  const gaveUp = report.givenUp.receipts + report.givenUp.authorMails + report.givenUp.outcomes;
  if (report.daily || report.receipts + report.statements + report.outcomeMails + gaveUp > 0 || report.urgent === "sent" || report.waiting === "sent") {
    deps.log.info({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, ...report }, "moderation-dispatch: round");
  }
  return report;
}

/** The job: a round every ten minutes, counted from the end of the one before, on one API instance at a time. */
export function createDispatchJob(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock) {
  return createJob({ name: DISPATCH_JOB, intervalMs: DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS, lockTtlMs: DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS, lock, log: deps.log, run: () => dispatchRound(deps, lock) });
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/statement.ts`

```ts
import { MEASURES, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind, type RuleId } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { DecisionMessage } from "../auth";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { endedMeasures, recordAuthorMail, statementActions, statementDecision, type MailState, type StatementDecisionRow } from "./repo";

/**
 * The data a statement of reasons and its mail are rendered from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10). A decision is the
 * statement: every element is a column, a ledger row or a saved text, read here into the one shape that @korbat/rules
 * renders for the mail, the author's screen and the console's preview. Nothing read here is changed by a later event, so
 * a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 */

/** A decision's statement with what mailing it needs: whom it is about, and whether its mail is still owed. */
export interface StatementFound {
  statement: DecisionStatement;
  decision: StatementDecisionRow;
}

/** Whether a field reset's old value was still kept when the decision that ends or lifts it was made, and where it can be read. */
function resetFacts(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind, held: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean }) {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  if (target !== "display_name" && target !== "bio") return { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null };
  // The reset's own snapshot holds the old value, by its compare-and-set; a reset that changed nothing removed none.
  return { resetDecisionId: held.decisionId, oldValueKept: held.noEffect === null && held.snapshotKept, resetRuleId: held.ruleId as RuleId | null };
}

/** The statement's data of one decision, or null when no decision has the id. */
export async function decisionStatement(q: ModerationDeps["apiDb"], decisionId: string): Promise<StatementFound | null> {
  const decision = await statementDecision(q, decisionId);
  if (!decision) return null;
  const actions = await statementActions(q, decisionId);
  const ended = decision.kind === "final" ? await endedMeasures(q, decisionId) : [];
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that restricts (it holds a measure), with a correction and with a
  // review. Those of a decision without a measure are the case's record, for staff: such a decision tells its author at
  // most that what korbat did while deciding has ended, so the statement's data holds neither, and no mail, screen or
  // export that is rendered from it can carry them.
  const told = decision.kind === "correction" || decision.kind === "review" || actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  const statement: DecisionStatement = {
    kind: decision.kind,
    outcome: decision.outcome as DecisionStatement["outcome"],
    ground: decision.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
    ruleId: decision.ruleId as RuleId | null,
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: decision.redressVersion,
    legalReference: decision.legalReference,
    facts: told ? decision.facts : null,
    reason: told ? decision.reason : null,
    source: decision.source as DecisionStatement["source"],
    decidedAt: decision.decidedAt,
    post: decision.targetType === "post" && decision.postCreatedAt !== null ? { id: decision.targetId, createdAt: decision.postCreatedAt } : null,
    measures: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as MeasureKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        noEffect: action.noEffect,
        sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: action.sealedPosts, images: action.sealedImages, deletedImages: action.sealedDeletedImages } : null,
      })),
    reversals: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as ReversalKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        ...(action.lifted === null ? { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } : resetFacts(action.kind, action.lifted)),
      })),
    endedMeasures: ended.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, ...resetFacts(measure.kind, measure) })),
    reviewed:
      decision.reviewed === null
        ? null
        : {
            kind: decision.reviewed.kind,
            ground: decision.reviewed.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
            ruleId: decision.reviewed.ruleId as RuleId | null,
            // The reviewed decision's own rulebook version: its rule is rendered as it was worded when that decision was made.
            rulesVersion: decision.reviewed.rulesVersion,
            legalReference: decision.reviewed.legalReference,
            decidedAt: decision.reviewed.decidedAt,
          },
  };
  return { statement, decision };
}

/**
 * The subject of the statement's mail, by the decision's kind and outcome (3c design, section 7.15), as a key of the mail
 * template's own table: a seal first, whatever else the decision holds; then a decision taken while deciding, on a post
 * or on an account; a final restriction; a final decision that restricts nothing but ends or lifts what was done while
 * deciding, and a correction of a decision taken while deciding; a reversal of a final decision; and a kept appeal.
 */
export function mailSubjectOf(statement: DecisionStatement): DecisionMessage["subject"] {
  const seals = statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media");
  const post = statement.post !== null;
  if (statement.kind === "interim") return seals ? "seal_deciding" : post ? "post_deciding" : "profile_deciding";
  if (statement.kind === "final") {
    if (seals) return "seal_final";
    if (statement.outcome === "restricted") return post ? "post_restricted" : "profile_restricted";
    return "lifted_deciding";
  }
  if (statement.kind === "correction") return statement.reviewed?.kind === "interim" ? "lifted_deciding" : "reversed";
  return statement.outcome === "kept" ? "appeal_kept" : "reversed";
}

/**
 * Mails a decision's statement to its author when that mail is still owed, and records what became of it: `sent`,
 * `no_address` for an account that is gone, `failed` when the relay refused the address for good. A failure of the relay
 * is thrown, and the mail stays pending for the dispatch job. Answers what was recorded, or "none" when nothing was owed.
 * The record is written only while the mail is still pending, so a late answer never overwrites one already recorded.
 */
export async function sendStatement(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth">, decisionId: string): Promise<MailState | "none"> {
  const found = await decisionStatement(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!found || found.decision.authorMail !== "pending") return "none";
  const subject = found.decision.subjectId;
  // The statement is rendered before anything is sent: one that cannot be rendered is no mail, and stays pending.
  const message: DecisionMessage = { template: "moderation_decision", subject: mailSubjectOf(found.statement), paragraphs: statementParagraphs(found.statement) };
  const result = subject === null ? "no_address" : await deps.auth.mailAccount(subject, message);
  // A stop of the address never holds a statement back, so "suppressed" is never answered for it.
  const state: MailState = result === "sent" ? "sent" : result === "refused" ? "failed" : "no_address";
  await recordAuthorMail(deps.apiDb, decisionId, state);
  return state;
}
```

### Create `packages/rules/src/statement.ts`

```ts
import { MEASURES, RETENTION, appealDeadline, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
// The rulebooks and the redress texts live in the index, which re-exports this module: the two import each other, and
// each uses the other's functions only when called, never while it loads.
import { getRedress, getRule } from "./index";

/**
 * The statement of reasons (3c design, section 10), as one pure function of a decision's data: the author's screen, the
 * console's preview and the mail all render it with this, so what the moderator previews is what the author gets. It
 * reads nothing but its input: the rule's words come from the rulebook version the decision was made under and the
 * redress text from its redress version, and which redress text applies follows from the decision's own kind and
 * outcome, never from a later event, so a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 *
 * It carries the six elements of Article 17(3) of the Digital Services Act: what was restricted, where and for how long;
 * the facts, and whether the decision followed a notice or korbat's own finding; whether automated means were used; the
 * legal ground or the rule, with its explanation; and the redress.
 */
export type StatementInput = DecisionStatement;

/** A time as korbat's mails print it: the date and the minute in UTC, since the reader's zone is unknown. */
function utcMinute(at: string | Date): string {
  const iso = (typeof at === "string" ? new Date(at) : at).toISOString();
  return `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 16)} UTC`;
}

const FIELD_NAMES = { display_name: "display name", bio: "bio" } as const;
type Field = keyof typeof FIELD_NAMES;

/** The field a reset or its lifting is about, or null for any other kind. */
function fieldOf(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind): Field | null {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  return target === "display_name" || target === "bio" ? target : null;
}

/**
 * The statement's fixed words, one place for each: the tests pin them, and the console's composer refers to them. A
 * sentence that names a post names it as "your post of {time}".
 */
export const STATEMENT_WORDS = {
  /** What was done, for each measure but the seal. `post` is the post's time as printed; `deciding` says that it was taken while korbat decides. */
  done: {
    withhold: (post: string) => `korbat hid your post of ${post} from other people while it decides.`,
    remove: (post: string) => `korbat removed your post of ${post}: other people can no longer see it.`,
    withhold_media: (post: string) => `korbat hid one image of your post of ${post} from other people while it decides.`,
    remove_media: (post: string) => `korbat removed one image of your post of ${post}: other people can no longer see it.`,
    reset: (field: Field, deciding: boolean) => `korbat reset your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]}${deciding ? " while it decides" : ""}.`,
  },
  resetOnce: (field: Field) =>
    `korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]} again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.`,
  /** A measure that changed nothing when it was imposed. */
  already: (what: "post" | "image") => `Another decision already keeps this ${what} from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
  alreadyField: "The field already held korbat's placeholder, so this changes nothing now.",
  alreadySealed: "Another decision already keeps these images sealed, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.",
  deletedPost: "You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.",
  deletedAccount: "Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.",
  /** The seal. Nobody at korbat has opened the images, so no sentence says what they show. */
  sealPost: (post: string, images: number) => `korbat sealed the images of your post of ${post} (${images} in all): nobody can see them, you included.`,
  sealAccount: (images: number, posts: number) => `korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (${images} on ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}): nobody can see them, you included.`,
  sealDeleted: (images: number) => `${images} of them ${images === 1 ? "is on a post" : "are on posts"} you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data).`,
  sealForGood: "They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.",
  sealAppeal: "An appeal of a seal waits until the authorities have assessed the images.",
  /** Reversals. */
  lifted: "korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.",
  liftedField: (field: Field) => `korbat lifted the reset of your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]}.`,
  unsealed: "korbat lifted the seal on these images. If an image is still not shown, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies.",
  /** What a reset's end or lifting leaves: korbat never writes the old value back. */
  field: (field: Field) => `korbat does not put back your ${FIELD_NAMES[field]} as it was before the reset: set it again in Settings, Profile if you wish.`,
  oldValueKept: `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days.`,
  oldValueKeptR4: `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days, unless korbat had already erased it under rule R4.`,
  ended: (measures: string) => `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${measures}.`,
  /** The lead of a correction and of a review: which decision it is about, by its time, and what became of it. */
  corrected: (decided: string, part: boolean) => `korbat corrected its decision of ${decided} and reversed ${part ? "part of it" : "it"}.`,
  interimLifted: (decided: string) => `korbat lifted what it did while deciding on ${decided}.`,
  reviewed: (decided: string, outcome: "kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed") =>
    `korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of ${decided} and ${outcome === "kept" ? "kept that decision" : outcome === "reversed" ? "reversed that decision" : "reversed part of that decision"}.`,
  noAction: "korbat decided to take no action.",
  /** Where a restriction applies and for how long. korbat cannot restrict by country, and a restriction on the law says so. */
  scope: {
    interim: "This applies everywhere korbat is available, for as long as korbat decides the case.",
    final: "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
    law: "korbat cannot restrict content for one country alone, so this applies everywhere, which is more than the law of a single country asks for.",
  },
  /** The source, as a category only: never a count, a reporter or a report's words. */
  source: {
    notice: "following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act",
    report: "following a report by another user",
    own_initiative: "found by a moderator",
  },
  automation: "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
} as const;

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;

/** The sentence that names the source: a notice or a report was followed, a moderator's finding was found. */
const sourceSentence = (source: StatementInput["source"]): string => (source === "own_initiative" ? `What this decision is about was ${W.source.own_initiative}.` : `korbat decided this ${W.source[source]}.`);

/** What a reset's end or lifting says of the field: korbat does not put the old value back, and where it can still be read. */
function fieldSentence(field: Field, reset: { oldValueKept: boolean; resetRuleId: string | null }): string {
  const parts: string[] = [W.field(field)];
  if (reset.oldValueKept) parts.push(reset.resetRuleId === "R4" ? W.oldValueKeptR4 : W.oldValueKept);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** One measure, as a paragraph: what was done, then that it changed nothing when it did not. */
function measureParagraph(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number]): string {
  const post = input.post === null ? null : utcMinute(input.post.createdAt);
  const deciding = input.kind === "interim";
  const field = fieldOf(measure.kind);
  if (measure.kind === "seal_media") {
    const sealed = measure.sealed ?? { posts: 0, images: 0, deletedImages: 0 };
    const parts: string[] = [post === null ? W.sealAccount(sealed.images, sealed.posts) : W.sealPost(post, sealed.images)];
    if (post === null && sealed.deletedImages > 0) parts.push(W.sealDeleted(sealed.deletedImages));
    if (input.kind === "final") parts.push(W.sealForGood);
    if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.alreadySealed);
    if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(post === null ? W.deletedAccount : W.deletedPost);
    return parts.join(" ");
  }
  if (field !== null) {
    const parts: string[] = [W.done.reset(field, deciding)];
    // A reset that changed something wrote the placeholder; one that changed nothing wrote nothing, and says so.
    if (measure.noEffect === null) parts.push(W.resetOnce(field));
    if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.alreadyField);
    if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(W.deletedAccount);
    return parts.join(" ");
  }
  if (post === null) throw new Error(`a statement's ${measure.kind} names its post: the decision's data holds none`);
  const done = measure.kind === "withhold" ? W.done.withhold(post) : measure.kind === "remove" ? W.done.remove(post) : measure.kind === "withhold_media" ? W.done.withhold_media(post) : W.done.remove_media(post);
  const parts: string[] = [done];
  if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.already(MEASURES[measure.kind].target === "image" ? "image" : "post"));
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(W.deletedPost);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** One reversal, as a paragraph. A lifted restriction of a post or an image names the post. */
function reversalParagraph(input: StatementInput, reversal: StatementInput["reversals"][number]): string {
  const field = fieldOf(reversal.kind);
  if (field !== null) return `${W.liftedField(field)} ${fieldSentence(field, reversal)}`;
  if (reversal.kind === "unseal_media") return W.unsealed;
  if (input.post === null) throw new Error(`a statement's ${reversal.kind} names its post: the decision's data holds none`);
  const post = utcMinute(input.post.createdAt);
  return `${reversal.kind === "restore_media" ? `One image of your post of ${post}` : `Your post of ${post}`}: ${W.lifted}`;
}

/** The measures taken while deciding that ended with the decision, and what becomes of each reset field the decision does not reset itself. */
function endedParagraph(input: StatementInput): string {
  const parts: string[] = [W.ended(input.endedMeasures.map((ended) => MEASURES[ended.kind].label).join(", "))];
  for (const ended of input.endedMeasures) {
    const field = fieldOf(ended.kind);
    if (field !== null && !input.measures.some((measure) => fieldOf(measure.kind) === field)) parts.push(fieldSentence(field, ended));
  }
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** The rule or the law a decision rests on. `own` words it for the decision itself, otherwise for the decision a review or a correction is about. */
function groundParagraph(ground: { ground: StatementInput["ground"]; ruleId: string | null; legalReference: string | null }, rulesVersion: number, own: boolean): string | null {
  if (ground.ground === "illegal") {
    const reference = ground.legalReference ?? "its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.";
    return own ? `korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: ${reference}` : `That decision rested on the law: ${reference}`;
  }
  if (ground.ground === "incompatible" && ground.ruleId !== null) {
    const rule = getRule(ground.ruleId, rulesVersion);
    // A decision records the version it was made under, and every version is kept: one that is missing is never rendered as another.
    if (!rule) throw new Error(`a statement cites ${ground.ruleId} of rulebook version ${rulesVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
    return `${own ? "It breaks" : "That decision rested on"} korbat rule ${rule.id}, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * The statement of reasons as paragraphs, in this order: what was done (one paragraph for each measure and each reversal,
 * then what ended); where it applies and for how long; how it came to korbat; that nothing was automated; the rule or the
 * law; the facts and the reason; and what the author can do about it.
 */
export function statementParagraphs(input: StatementInput): string[] {
  const redress = getRedress(input.redressVersion);
  if (!redress) throw new Error(`a statement names the redress texts of version ${input.redressVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
  const paragraphs: string[] = [];
  const about = input.kind === "review" || input.kind === "correction";
  const restricts = input.measures.length > 0;

  // What was done.
  if (about) {
    if (input.reviewed === null) throw new Error("the statement of a review or a correction names the decision it is about: the decision's data holds none");
    const decided = utcMinute(input.reviewed.decidedAt);
    if (input.kind === "review") paragraphs.push(W.reviewed(decided, input.outcome === "kept" ? "kept" : input.outcome === "partly_reversed" ? "partly_reversed" : "reversed"));
    else paragraphs.push(input.reviewed.kind === "interim" ? W.interimLifted(decided) : W.corrected(decided, input.outcome === "partly_reversed"));
  }
  for (const measure of input.measures) paragraphs.push(measureParagraph(input, measure));
  for (const reversal of input.reversals) paragraphs.push(reversalParagraph(input, reversal));
  if (input.endedMeasures.length > 0) paragraphs.push(endedParagraph(input));
  if (paragraphs.length === 0) paragraphs.push(W.noAction);

  // Where and how long: only a decision that restricts has a scope.
  if (restricts) {
    paragraphs.push(input.kind === "interim" ? W.scope.interim : W.scope.final);
    if (input.ground === "illegal") paragraphs.push(W.scope.law);
  }

  // How it came to korbat, for a decision of its own; a review or a correction is korbat's own second look.
  if (!about) paragraphs.push(sourceSentence(input.source));
  paragraphs.push(W.automation);

  // The rule or the law: the decision's own, or for a review or a correction the reviewed decision's, from that decision's
  // row and in the wording of the rulebook that decision was made under.
  const ground = about ? groundParagraph(input.reviewed!, input.reviewed!.rulesVersion, false) : groundParagraph(input, input.rulesVersion, true);
  if (ground !== null) paragraphs.push(ground);

  // The facts and the reason, while korbat keeps them.
  if (input.facts !== null) paragraphs.push(`The facts: ${input.facts}`);
  if (input.reason !== null) paragraphs.push(about ? `Why korbat ${input.outcome === "kept" ? "kept" : "changed"} it: ${input.reason}` : `korbat's reasons: ${input.reason}`);

  // Redress, from the decision's own kind and outcome.
  if (input.kind === "interim") paragraphs.push(redress.interim);
  else if (input.kind === "final" && input.outcome === "restricted") {
    const appeal = redress.appeal.replace("{deadline}", () => utcMinute(appealDeadline(new Date(input.decidedAt))));
    paragraphs.push(input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media") ? `${appeal} ${W.sealAppeal}` : appeal);
  } else paragraphs.push(redress.notAppealable);
  return paragraphs;
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "./api";
import type { SignalApi } from "./enroll";
import { Layout, Masthead } from "./Layout";
import { describeError } from "./messages";
import { NavLink } from "./nav";
import type { ConsolePath } from "./router";
import { Audit } from "./screens/Audit";
import { CaseScreen } from "./screens/Case";
import { Enroll } from "./screens/Enroll";
import { Home } from "./screens/Home";
import { Queue } from "./screens/Queue";
import { SignIn } from "./screens/SignIn";
import { Unavailable } from "./screens/Unavailable";
import type { ConsoleStore } from "./store";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The console's page (3a design, section 9): the screen for the address and the session. An enrolment link needs no
 * session; every other page shows sign-in in place while there is none, at its own address, and its own screen after.
 */
export function App({ store, credentials, signal }: { store: ConsoleStore; credentials: CredentialsLike; signal: SignalApi | undefined }) {
  const state = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.get, store.get);
  const [signOutError, setSignOutError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { api } = store;
  const { session, route } = state;

  if (session.kind === "unavailable") return <Unavailable />;

  if (route.name === "enroll") {
    return (
      <>
        <Masthead />
        <main>
          <Enroll token={route.token} api={api} credentials={credentials} signal={signal} onUnavailable={store.unavailable} />
        </main>
      </>
    );
  }

  if (session.kind !== "signed-in") {
    return (
      <>
        <Masthead />
        <main>
          {session.kind === "checking" ? <p className="quiet">Loading</p> : null}
          {session.kind === "failed" ? (
            <section className="panel">
              <p role="alert" className="error">
                {session.message}
              </p>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void store.start()}>
                Try again
              </button>
            </section>
          ) : null}
          {session.kind === "signed-out" ? <SignIn ended={session.ended} api={api} credentials={credentials} onSignedIn={store.signedIn} onUnavailable={store.unavailable} /> : null}
        </main>
      </>
    );
  }

  const signOut = async () => {
    setSignOutError(null);
    try {
      await api.signOut({ activity: true });
      store.signedOut();
    } catch (err) {
      // A session that had already ended has shown sign-in through the 401; any other failure leaves the session as it was.
      if (!(err instanceof ApiError && err.code === "staff_session_required")) setSignOutError(describeError(err));
    }
  };

  const navigate = (path: ConsolePath) => {
    setSignOutError(null);
    store.navigate(path);
  };

  return (
    <Layout me={session.me} path={state.path} warning={state.warning} onNavigate={navigate} onSignOut={() => void signOut()} onStay={() => void store.stay()}>
      {signOutError ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {signOutError}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {route.name === "home" || route.name === "signin" ? <Home me={session.me} api={api} credentials={credentials} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {route.name === "audit" ? <Audit api={api} /> : null}
      {route.name === "queue" ? <Queue api={api} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {/* Keyed by the case: another case's page starts with nothing of this one's. */}
      {route.name === "case" ? <CaseScreen key={route.id} id={route.id} api={api} credentials={credentials} role={session.me.role} drafts={store.drafts} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {route.name === "appeals" ? (
        <section aria-labelledby="appeals-title">
          <h2 id="appeals-title">Appeals</h2>
          <p>Appeals arrive later in sub-project 3c. The home page says how many wait.</p>
        </section>
      ) : null}
      {route.name === "unknown" ? (
        <section aria-labelledby="unknown-title">
          <h2 id="unknown-title">No such page</h2>
          <p>There is no page at this address.</p>
          <p>
            <NavLink to="/" onNavigate={navigate}>
              Go to the home page
            </NavLink>
          </p>
        </section>
      ) : null}
    </Layout>
  );
}
```
